7054.en: Are those diamond earrings a gift from your boyfriend?
7054.zh: 那些鑽石耳環是你男朋友送的禮物嗎？

7055.en: Finding full-time employment is his main goal now.
7055.zh: 找到全職工作是他現在的主要目標。

7055.en: The government aims to boost employment among young people.
7055.zh: 政府的目標是提升年輕人的就業率。

7056.en: Her teacher's words gave her a lot of encouragement.
7056.zh: 她老師的話給了她很大的鼓勵。

7056.en: We need more encouragement instead of harsh criticism.
7056.zh: 我們需要更多的鼓勵而不是嚴厲的批評。

7057.en: The children shouted with excitement upon seeing the animals.
7057.zh: 孩子們看到動物時興奮地大喊。

7057.en: I could not hide my excitement about the upcoming trip.
7057.zh: 我無法掩飾對於即將到來旅行的興奮心情。

7058.en: There is a big improvement in his English writing.
7058.zh: 他的英文寫作有了很大的進步。

7058.en: We must make some improvements to the service quality.
7058.zh: 我們必須對服務品質進行一些改善。

7059.en: Good time management helps students reduce stress.
7059.zh: 良好的時間管理有助於學生減輕壓力。

7059.en: The new management team plans to improve sales.
7059.zh: 新的管理團隊計劃要提高銷售量。

7060.en: Take the measurement of the room before buying furniture.
7060.zh: 買傢俱之前先量一下房間的尺寸。

7060.en: Weight is a measurement of how heavy something is.
7060.zh: 重量是用來衡量某樣東西有多重的標準。

7061.en: He accepted his punishment without any complaints.
7061.zh: 他毫無怨言地接受了他的處罰。

7061.en: Severe punishment is not always the best solution.
7061.zh: 嚴厲的懲罰不見得總是最好的解決辦法。

7062.en: Good English skills are a requirement for this job.
7062.zh: 良好的英語能力是這份工作的必備條件。

7062.en: Graduation requirements include passing a computer test.
7062.zh: 畢業要求包含通過一項電腦測驗。

7063.en: They reached a peaceful settlement after a long talk.
7063.zh: 經過長談後，他們達成了和平協議。

7063.en: The ancient settlement was discovered near the river.
7063.zh: 這處古代聚落是在河邊被發現的。

7064.en: Please take off your shoes and put on these slippers.
7064.zh: 請脫掉鞋子，然後換上這些拖鞋。

7064.en: She likes to wear soft slippers inside the house.
7064.zh: 她喜歡在屋子裡穿柔軟的拖鞋。

7065.en: He put on a pair of warm socks for winter.
7065.zh: 他為了過冬穿上了一雙保暖的襪子。

7065.en: Where did you put my clean white socks?
7065.zh: 你把我乾淨的白襪子放在哪裡了？

7066.en: The police asked him to make a written statement.
7066.zh: 警方要求他做一份書面筆錄。

7066.en: Her opening statement caught everyone's attention.
7066.zh: 她的開場白吸引了所有人的注意。

7067.en: We took a walk in the woods.
The old cabin is hidden in the woods.
7067.zh: 那間老木屋隱藏在樹林中。

7068.en: Winning the science fair was a great achievement.
7068.zh: 贏得科學展覽是一項很大的成就。

7068.en: She felt a sense of achievement after graduating.
7068.zh: 她畢業後感到很有成就感。

7069.en: I saw an advertisement for a new smartphone.
7069.zh: 我看到一支新智慧型手機的廣告。

7069.en: That company places advertisements on social media.
7069.zh: 那家公司在社群媒體上投放廣告。

7070.en: He found a part-time job through an online ad.
7070.zh: 他透過網路廣告找到一份兼職工作。

7070.en: Skip this ad to watch the video now.
7070.zh: 跳過這個廣告即可立即觀看影片。

7071.en: To my amazement, she passed the difficult exam.
7071.zh: 令我驚訝的是，她通過了那場困難的考試。

7071.en: The children watched the magic show in amazement.
7071.zh: 孩子們驚奇地看著魔術表演。

7072.en: The principal made an important announcement this morning.
7072.zh: 校長今天早上做了重要的公告。

7072.en: They are waiting for the announcement of exam results.
7072.zh: 他們正在等待考試成績的公佈。

7073.en: They announced their engagement to their close friends.
7073.zh: 他們向至親好友宣布了訂婚的消息。

7073.en: I cannot come tonight because of a prior engagement.
7073.zh: 我今晚因為有約在先，所以不能來。

7074.en: People should not ride bicycles on the pavement.
7074.zh: 人們不應該在人行道上騎腳踏車。

7074.en: He slipped on the wet pavement and fell down.
7074.zh: 他在濕滑的人行道上滑倒了。

7075.en: The sudden rain caused the postponement of the outdoor concert.
7075.zh: 突如其來的大雨導致戶外演唱會延期。

7075.en: We were disappointed by the postponement of our trip.
7075.zh: 我們對這次行程的延期感到很失望。

7076.en: We need to find a replacement for the broken chair.
7076.zh: 我們需要為這張壞掉的椅子找個替代品。

7076.en: She is the best replacement we could possibly hire.
7076.zh: 她可能是我們能聘用到的最佳接替人選。

7077.en: He put all his savings into buying a new apartment.
7077.zh: 他把他所有的積蓄都拿去買新公寓了。

7077.en: Opening a bank account helps you build up your savings.
7077.zh: 開立銀行帳戶有助於你累積存款。

7078.en: Step on the bathroom scales to check your weight.
7078.zh: 站上浴室的體重計來量量你的體重。

7078.en: The fish was covered in shiny scales from head to tail.
7078.zh: 這隻魚從頭到尾都覆蓋著閃亮的魚鱗。

7079.en: Workers demanded higher wages and better working conditions.
7079.zh: 工人們要求調高薪資並改善工作環境。

7079.en: He spends his weekly wages on video games and clothes.
7079.zh: 他把每週的薪水都花在電動玩具和衣服上。

7080.en: Graduating from college is a major accomplishment in life.
7080.zh: 大學畢業是人生中的一項重大成就。

7080.en: She felt a great sense of accomplishment after finishing the marathon.
7080.zh: 跑完馬拉松後，她感到一股巨大的成就感。

7081.en: Moving to a new city requires some social adjustment.
7081.zh: 搬到新城市需要一些社交方面的調適。

7081.en: Make a small adjustment to the seat before driving.
7081.zh: 開車前把座椅做個小調整。

7082.en: To my amusement, the puppy chased its own tail.
7082.zh: 令我感到好笑的是，那隻小狗竟然追著自己的尾巴跑。

7082.en: The theme park is a popular place of amusement for kids.
7082.zh: 這個主題樂園是深受小孩喜愛的好去處。

7083.en: I need to make an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.
7083.zh: 我明天需要跟牙醫預約看診。

7083.en: She arrived on time for her job interview appointment.
7083.zh: 她準時到達她的工作面試約定。

7084.en: We have to finish this difficult math assignment by Friday.
7084.zh: 我們必須在週五前完成這個困難的數學作業。

7084.en: The teacher gave us a special project assignment today.
7084.zh: 老師今天指派給我們一個特別的專題任務。

7085.en: Please check the photo attachment in my latest email.
7085.zh: 請檢查我最新一封電子郵件中的照片附件。

7085.en: Children often develop a strong attachment to their blankets.
7085.zh: 孩子們通常會對他們的被子產生強烈的依戀。

7086.en: Modern capitalism encourages free markets and business competition.
7086.zh: 現代資本主義鼓勵自由市場與商業競爭。

7086.en: Some people debate whether capitalism helps reduce global poverty.
7086.zh: 有些人爭論資本主義是否有助於減少全球貧窮。

7087.en: True contentment comes from appreciating the simple things.
7087.zh: 真正的滿足感來自於珍惜簡單的事物。

7087.en: He found peace and contentment living in the countryside.
7087.zh: 他住在鄉下找到了平靜與滿足。

7088.en: To my great disappointment, the concert was canceled today.
7088.zh: 令我非常失望的是，今天的音樂會取消了。

7088.en: She tried to hide her disappointment after losing the game.
7088.zh: 她在輸掉比賽後試著掩飾她的失望。

7089.en: Never let temporary failure cause you to feel total discouragement.
7089.zh: 千萬別讓暫時的失敗使你感到徹底的氣餒。

7089.en: He faced much discouragement before achieving his final goal.
7089.zh: 他在達成最終目標前面臨了許多的挫折。

7090.en: I blushed with embarrassment when I forgot his name.
7090.zh: 當我忘記他的名字時，我尷尬得臉紅了。

7090.en: To save himself from embarrassment, he changed the subject.
7090.zh: 為了避免自己感到尷尬，他轉移了話題。

7091.en: Strict traffic enforcement helps keep our city streets safe.
7091.zh: 嚴格的交通執法有助於維護我們城市街道的安全。

7091.en: The new law requires better enforcement by local police officers.
7091.zh: 這項新法律需要當地警察更好的執行。

7092.en: The school plans an enlargement of its computer laboratory.
7092.zh: 學校計畫擴建其電腦實驗室。

7092.en: She ordered a photo enlargement to hang in her living room.
7092.zh: 她訂做了一張照片放大照掛在客廳裡。

7093.en: Streaming services provide endless entertainment for teenagers today.
7093.zh: 串流服務為現今的青少年提供無盡的娛樂。

7093.en: They went downtown looking for some good food and entertainment.
7093.zh: 他們去市中心尋找一些美食和娛樂。

7094.en: Camping equipment can be quite expensive for beginners to buy.
7094.zh: 露營裝備對初學者來說買起來可能相當昂貴。

7094.en: The gym is filled with modern exercise equipment for students.
7094.zh: 這間健身房擺滿了供學生使用的現代健身器材。

7095.en: The establishment of the new nature reserve took five years.
7095.zh: 建立這個新的自然保護區花了五年時間。

7095.en: This local bakery is a popular establishment in our neighborhood.
7095.zh: 這家在地麵包店是我們社區裡很受歡迎的店鋪。

7096.en: She found true fulfillment in helping underprivileged children learn.
7096.zh: 她在幫助弱勢兒童學習中找到了真正的成就感。

7096.en: The company guarantees the prompt fulfillment of all online orders.
7096.zh: 公司保證迅速完成所有網路訂單。

7098.en: Real estate is considered a safe investment for long-term savings.
7098.zh: 房地產被認為是長期儲蓄的安全投資。

7098.en: Education is the best investment you can make for your future.
7098.zh: 教育是你為未來能做出的最好投資。

7099.en: His active involvement in club activities made his high school memorable.
7099.zh: 他積極參與社團活動，讓他的高中生活令人難忘。

7099.en: Parents' involvement in school events creates a stronger community.
7099.zh: 家長參與學校活動能建立更緊密的社區。

7100.en: The government took strict measures to reduce air pollution.
7100.zh: 政府採取了嚴格的措施來減少空氣污染。

7100.en: We need to take safety measures before starting the experiment.
7100.zh: 我們在開始實驗前必須採取安全措施。

7101.en: My grandfather is planning a relaxing trip after his retirement.
7101.zh: 我爺爺正計畫在他退休後進行一趟輕鬆的旅行。

7101.en: She saved a lot of money for her retirement life.
7101.zh: 她為自己的退休生活存了許多錢。

7102.en: These statistics show a clear rise in online shopping.
7102.zh: 這些統計數據顯示網路購物的明顯成長。

7102.en: He is taking a difficult statistics class this semester.
7102.zh: 他這學期修了一門困難的統計學課程。

7103.en: The children hung their Christmas stockings by the fireplace.
7103.zh: 孩子們把聖誕襪掛在壁爐旁。

7103.en: She wore black stockings to match her winter dress.
7103.zh: 她穿著黑色長襪來搭配她的冬裙。

7104.en: He shook his head in acknowledgment of the difficult situation.
7104.zh: 他搖搖頭，表示承認這個困境。

7104.en: She received a quick acknowledgment of her job application.
7104.zh: 她很快就收到求職申請的收件回條。

7105.en: The teacher gave us a weekly assessment of our vocabulary.
7105.zh: 老師對我們的單字量進行了每週評量。

7105.en: His assessment of the project's risks was very accurate.
7105.zh: 他對該專案風險的評估非常準確。

7106.en: To my astonishment, she passed the difficult exam easily.
7106.zh: 令我驚訝的是，她輕鬆通過了那場困難的考試。

7106.en: He looked at the broken vase in total astonishment.
7106.zh: 他滿臉驚愕地看著那個打破的花瓶。

7107.en: The famous singer signed a profitable product endorsement deal.
7107.zh: 這位知名歌手簽了一筆利潤豐厚的產品代言合約。

7107.en: The mayor won the election with the union's strong endorsement.
7107.zh: 市長在工會的大力支持下贏得了選舉。

7108.en: Medical ethics strictly forbid doctors to share patients' secrets.
7108.zh: 醫療倫理嚴格禁止醫生洩漏病人的祕密。

7108.en: The politician's business ethics were questioned by the public.
7108.zh: 這位政治人物的商業道德受到了大眾的質疑。

7109.en: The coach changed our defensive tactics during the halftime break.
7109.zh: 教練在中場休息時改變了我們的防守戰術。

7109.en: Good negotiation tactics can help you close the deal faster.
7109.zh: 好的談判策略能幫你更快談成這筆生意。

7110.en: Winning the science fair was a great educational attainment.
7110.zh: 贏得科學展覽是個很棒的教育成就。

7110.en: Language attainment requires daily practice and lots of patience.
7110.zh: 語言造詣需要每日的練習與許多的耐心。

7111.en: We need some software enhancement to make the system faster.
7111.zh: 我們需要一些軟體升級來讓系統跑得更快。

7111.en: The photo enhancement tool made her pictures look much brighter.
7111.zh: 照片美化工具讓她的照片看起來明亮許多。

7112.en: He traveled to India in search of spiritual enlightenment.
7112.zh: 他前往印度尋求心靈的啟發。

7112.en: The Age of Enlightenment brought major changes to European society.
7112.zh: 啟蒙時代為歐洲社會帶來了重大的改變。

7113.en: After-school clubs provide cultural enrichment for high school students.
7113.zh: 課後社團為高中生提供文化的充實。

7113.en: Reading books is a great way for personal enrichment.
7113.zh: 閱讀書籍是充實自我的一個好方法。

7114.en: College enrollment usually increases during economic downturns.
7114.zh: 大學入學人數通常在經濟不景氣時會增加。

7114.en: The school saw a huge drop in student enrollment this year.
7114.zh: 這所學校今年的學生註冊人數大幅下降。

7115.en: The company has a zero-tolerance policy for sexual harassment.
7115.zh: 公司對性騷擾採取零容忍的政策。

7115.en: Online harassment has become a serious problem for teenagers.
7115.zh: 網路霸凌已經成為青少年的一個嚴重問題。

7116.en: She always listens to music with her headphones on.
7116.zh: 她總是戴著耳機聽音樂。

7116.en: Please put on your headphones so you won't disturb others.
7116.zh: 請戴上耳機，這樣才不會打擾到別人。

7117.en: The criminal was sentenced to ten years of imprisonment.
7117.zh: 這名罪犯被判處十年有期徒刑。

7117.en: He spent years in imprisonment for a crime he didn't do.
7117.zh: 他因為一場沒做過的犯罪而坐了多年牢。

7118.en: Plants get their nourishment from the soil and sunlight.
7118.zh: 植物從土壤和陽光中獲取養分。

7118.en: Sick people need good food to provide proper nourishment.
7118.zh: 生病的人需要好的食物來提供適當的營養。

7119.en: Her speech showed a high level of elegance and refinement.
7119.zh: 她的演說展現出高度的優雅與講究。

7119.en: The new design needs a few more refinements before release.
7119.zh: 這個新設計在發布前還需要一些細部的修改。

7120.en: A cold drink is a great refreshment on a hot day.
7120.zh: 在大熱天裡，一杯冷飲是很棒的消暑方式。

7120.en: She stopped for a moment of refreshment after running.
7120.zh: 她在跑步後停下來休息一下、提提神。

7121.en: Light refreshments will be served after the meeting.
7121.zh: 會議結束後將會供應簡單的茶點。

7121.en: The guests enjoyed the drinks and refreshments very much.
7121.zh: 客人們非常享受這些飲料與茶點。

7122.en: He felt a deep sense of resentment toward his boss.
7122.zh: 他对老闆感到非常不满。

7122.en: Her unfair treatment caused a lot of resentment among the staff.
7122.zh: 她不公平的对待在員工之間引起了許多怨恨。

7123.en: I always wear comfortable sneakers when I go hiking.
7123.zh: 我去健行時總是穿著舒適的球鞋。

7123.en: He bought a brand new pair of sneakers yesterday.
7123.zh: 他昨天買了一雙全新的運動鞋。

7124.en: We had dinner first and went to the movies afterwards.
7124.zh: 我們先吃晚餐，後來去看電影。

7124.en: She felt tired during the exam but relaxed afterwards.
7124.zh: 她在考試時覺得很累，但事后放鬆了。

7125.en: The little boy tried to walk backwards for fun.
7125.zh: 小男孩好玩試著往後走。

7125.en: Can you spell your name backwards in English?
7125.zh: 你能把你的英文名字倒著拼出來嗎？

7126.en: Please check the contents of the package carefully.
7126.zh: 請仔細檢查包裹裡的內容物。

7126.en: You can find the chapter titles in the table of contents.
7126.zh: 你可以在目錄裡找到章節標題。

7127.en: The coach told the players to run forwards quickly.
7127.zh: 教練叫球員們快點向前跑。

7127.en: Technology keeps moving forwards very fast today.
7127.zh: 如今科技持續非常快速地向前邁進。

7128.en: It is unwise to make a quick judgment about people.
7128.zh: 對別人妄下判斷是不明智的。

7128.en: She showed good judgment in solving that difficult problem.
7128.zh: 她在解決那個難題時展現了良好的判斷力。

7129.en: Children usually love eating sweets and chocolate very much.
7129.zh: 小孩子通常非常喜歡吃糖果和巧克力。

7129.en: My dentist told me to cut down on sweets.
7129.zh: 我的牙醫師叫我少吃甜食。

7130.en: Tears came to her eyes when she heard the news.
7130.zh: 她聽到這個消息時不禁淚流滿面。

7130.en: He tried to hide his tears in front of friends.
7130.zh: 他試著在朋友面前掩飾他的淚水。

7131.en: The cute dog started running towards us happily.
7131.zh: 那隻可愛的狗狗開心地開始朝我們跑來。

7131.en: We should show more kindness towards stray animals.
7131.zh: 我們應該對流浪動物展現更多善意。

7132.en: I usually get up early on weekdays to study.
7132.zh: 我通常在平日早起讀書。

7132.en: The library is always quiet during weekdays.
7132.zh: 圖書館在平日時總是安安靜靜的。

145.en: Eating a fresh carrot is good for our eyes.
145.zh: 吃新鮮的紅蘿蔔對我們的眼睛很好。

145.en: She added some chopped carrots to the soup.
145.zh: 她往湯裡加了一些切碎的紅蘿蔔。

268.en: Can I borrow your eraser to fix this mistake?
268.zh: 我可以借你的橡皮擦來修正這個錯誤嗎？

268.en: He lost his favorite eraser during the exam.
268.zh: 他在考試期間弄丟了他最喜歡的橡皮擦。

416.en: My mother works hard as a full-time housewife.
416.zh: 我媽媽身為全職家庭主婦，非常辛苦。

416.en: Many housewives joined the community cooking class.
416.zh: 許多家庭主婦參加了社區烹飪課。

495.en: She bit her lip because she was so nervous.

1882.en: Strong winds made the tall trees swing wildly.
1882.zh: 強風使得高大的樹木劇烈搖晃。

1896.en: Global leaders are working together to fight terrorism.
1896.zh: 全球領袖正攜手合作打擊恐怖主義。

1896.en: Terrorism remains a serious threat to world peace.
1896.zh: 恐怖主義依然是對世界和平的嚴重威脅。

1944.en: Students must upload their assignments before the strict midnight deadline.
1944.zh: 學生必須在嚴格的午夜期限前上傳他們的作業。

1944.en: She tried to upload the large video file, but the internet failed.
1944.zh: 她試圖上傳那個大影片檔案，但網路卻斷線了。

1969.en: Traffic is always heavy on this busy road every weekday morning.
1969.zh: 每個平日早晨，這條繁忙的道路上交通總是十分擁擠。

1969.en: He usually goes to the local gym twice a weekday.
1969.zh: 他通常每個平日去當地健身房兩次。

1972.en: Many students enjoy learning about western history and culture.
1972.zh: 許多學生喜歡了解西方歷史與文化。

1972.en: The western style restaurant offers delicious food and great service.
1972.zh: 那家西式餐廳提供美味的食物和棒極了的服務。

1990.en: The lonely wolf howled loudly under the bright moonlight.
1990.zh: 孤獨的野狼在明亮的月光下大聲嚎叫著。

1990.en: We saw a wolf running quickly across the snowy forest.
1990.zh: 我們看到一隻野狼快速跑過積雪的森林。

1995.en: Please open your English workbook to page twenty-five now.
1995.zh: 現在請把你們的英文習作本翻到第二十五頁。

1995.en: The teacher checked every student's workbook after class yesterday.
1995.zh: 老師昨天下課後檢查了每一位學生的習作本。

2001.en: My grandmother cooked a sweet yam soup for dinner tonight.
2001.zh: 我奶奶今晚晚餐煮了香甜的地瓜湯。

2001.en: Eating a baked yam is a great way to stay warm.
2001.zh: 吃一顆烤地瓜是保持溫暖的好方法。

2003.en: The black and white zebra ran fast across the grassland.
2003.zh: 黑白相間的斑馬在草原上快速奔跑著。

2003.en: We watched a cute baby zebra drinking water with its mother.
2003.zh: 我們看著一隻可愛的小斑馬和牠的媽媽一起喝水。

2005.en: His poor test score is barely acceptable to his parents.
2005.zh: 他糟糕的考試成績讓他的父母勉強可以接受。

2005.en: Is it acceptable to submit the research report next Monday?
2005.zh: 下週一才繳交研究報告是可以被接受的嗎？

2015.en: My academic adviser helped me choose the right college courses.
2015.zh: 我的學業顧問幫我選擇了合適的大學課程。

2015.en: The club advisor gave us useful advice for the school fair.
2015.zh: 社團指導老師為我們的學校義賣會提供了實用的建議。

2023.en: The talented young musician never fails to amaze the audience.
2023.zh: 這位才華洋溢的年輕音樂家總能驚豔觀眾。

2023.en: We were all amaze by the breathtaking view from the mountain.
2023.zh: 我們都被從山上俯瞰的壯麗景色給驚豔到了。

2030.en: Anyhow, we should finish this project before the weekend.
2030.zh: 無論如何，我們應該在週末前完成這個專案。

2030.en: It was raining hard, but she went out anyhow.
2030.zh: 當時雨下得很大，但她還是硬要出門。

2035.en: The chef wore a clean white apron in the kitchen.
2035.zh: 主廚在廚房裡穿著一件乾淨的白色圍裙。

2035.en: She wiped her hands on her apron before answering.
2035.zh: 她在圍裙上擦了擦手才回答。

2052.en: The loud noise outside the window began to awaken him.
2052.zh: 窗外的巨大噪音開始吵醒了他。

2052.en: This sad story can awaken our awareness of animal rights.
2052.zh: 這個悲傷的故事能喚起我們對動物權利的意識。

2065.en: My uncle works as a senior banker in Taipei.
2065.zh: 我叔叔在台北擔任資深銀行家。

2065.en: The young banker gave us some useful financial advice.
2065.zh: 這位年輕的銀行家給了我們一些實用的理財建議。

2068.en: The farmers stored hay and tools inside the old barn.
2068.zh: 農夫們把乾草和工具存放在舊穀倉裡。

2068.en: Several horses were resting peacefully in the wooden barn.
2068.zh: 幾匹馬正安詳地在木造穀倉裡休息。

2069.en: Rainwater was collected in a large wooden barrel outside.
2069.zh: 雨水被收集在戶外的一個大木桶裡。

2069.en: The old wine barrel had a strong and rich aroma.
2069.zh: 這個老舊的酒桶散發出濃郁的香氣。

2072.en: She made a beautiful necklace using colorful glass beads.
2072.zh: 她用五顏六色的玻璃珠做了一条漂亮的項鍊。

2072.en: Beads of sweat rolled down his forehead during the exam.
2072.zh: 考試時，汗珠從他的額頭滾落下來。

2073.en: A bright beam of light cut through the dark night.
2073.zh: 一道明亮的光束劃破了黑暗的夜晚。

2073.en: The proud father began to beam when his son won.
2073.zh: 當兒子獲勝時，這位驕傲的父親笑逐顏開。

2074.en: The fairy tale tells a story of a beauty and a beast.
2074.zh: 這部童話故事講述了一個美女與野獸的故事。

2074.en: Wild beasts roam freely in the vast African grassland.
2074.zh: 野生猛獸在遼闊的非洲草原上自由漫步。

2078.en: We picked fresh strawberries and blueberries at the local farm.
2078.zh: 我們在當地農場採摘新鮮的草莓和藍莓。

2078.en: Not every red berry you find in the woods is edible.
2078.zh: 你在樹林裡找到的紅色漿果並非每一種都可以食用。

2085.en: The detective examined the bloody knife found in the dark alley.
2085.zh: 偵探檢查了在暗巷中發現的那把帶血的刀子。

2085.en: He suffered a bloody nose after falling off his new bicycle.
2085.zh: 他從新腳踏車上摔下來後流鼻血了。

2087.en: She made a bold decision to quit her stable job.
2087.zh: 她做出了辭掉穩定工作的勇敢決定。

2087.en: The teacher wrote the important grammar rules in bold letters.
2087.zh: 老師用粗體字寫下了重要的文法規則。

2095.en: The firefighter showed great bravery by running into the fire.
2095.zh: 消防員衝入火場，展現了極大的勇敢。

2095.en: We all admired her bravery when facing difficult health challenges.
2095.zh: 面對艱難的健康挑戰，我們都很佩服她的勇敢。

2099.en: A cool breeze blew across the playground during the afternoon break.
2099.zh: 下午休息時間，一陣涼爽的微風吹過操場。

2099.en: With proper preparation, the English test will be a breeze.
2099.zh: 只要準備充分，這次的英文考試將會輕而易舉。

2100.en: The old school building was constructed entirely of red brick.
2100.zh: 這棟老舊的學校建築完全是用紅磚建造的。

2100.en: He accidentally dropped a heavy brick on his right foot.
2100.zh: 他不小心把一塊重磚頭掉在右腳上。

2103.en: My friends and I plan to have brunch this Sunday morning.
2103.zh: 我和朋友計畫在這個週日早晨去吃早午餐。

2103.en: They ordered pancakes and coffee at the new brunch café.
2103.zh: 他們在那家新開的早午餐咖啡廳點了鬆餅和咖啡。

2104.en: The little boy blew colorful soap bubbles in the sunny park.
2104.zh: 小男孩在陽光普照的公園裡吹著彩色泡泡。

2104.en: House prices in the city are rising like a financial bubble.
2104.zh: 這座城市的房價正像金融泡沫一樣不斷上漲。

2108.en: Large herds of buffalo roam freely across the grassy plains.
2108.zh: 大群的水牛在長滿青草的原野上自由漫步。

2108.en: We saw several water buffalo resting peacefully in the muddy river.
2108.zh: 我們看到幾隻水牛安詳地在混濁的河水中休息。

2120.en: He forgot to bring his charging cable for the smartphone.
2120.zh: 他忘記帶智慧型手機的充電線了。

2120.en: The heavy bridge is supported by thick steel cables.
2120.zh: 這座沉重的橋樑是由粗厚的鋼纜支撐的。

2123.en: Tourists love to take photos of the deep and scenic canyon.
2123.zh: 遊客們喜歡拍攝那座深邃且風景優美的峽谷。

2123.en: The river carved this massive canyon over millions of years.
2123.zh: 這條河流經過數百萬年的侵蝕，雕刻出了這個巨大的峽谷。

2130.en: The old train carriage was filled with tired passengers.
2130.zh: 那節老舊的火車車廂裡擠滿了疲憊的旅客。

2130.en: A horse-drawn carriage took the couple around the park.
2130.zh: 一輛馬車載著這對夫妻繞著公園逛。

2132.en: The injured player had a plaster cast on his leg.
2132.zh: 受傷的球員腿上打著石膏繃帶。

2132.en: The director chose talented actors for the new movie cast.
2132.zh: 導演為新電影的演員陣容挑選了有才華的演員。

2144.en: Remember to wear a heavy jacket because it is chilly.
2144.zh: 記得穿厚外套，因為天氣有點涼意。

2144.en: A chilly wind blew through the empty streets at night.
2144.zh: 夜晚一陣寒風吹過空無一人的街道。

2148.en: Mom used a sharp knife to chop the fresh vegetables.
2148.zh: 媽媽用銳利的刀子切碎新鮮蔬菜。

2148.en: He had to chop some wood for the winter fire.
2148.zh: 他必須劈一些木頭來生冬天的火。

2150.en: Let us go to the local cinema to watch a movie.
2150.zh: 我們去當地的電影院看場電影吧。

2150.en: The historic cinema downtown will be closed for repairs.
2150.zh: 市中心那間歷史悠久的電影院將關閉整修。

2151.en: The traveling circus brought joy to children every summer.
2151.zh: 巡迴馬戲團每年夏天都帶給孩子們歡樂。

2151.en: We watched acrobats perform amazing stunts at the circus.
2151.zh: 我們在馬戲團觀賞特技演員表演驚人的特技。

2154.en: Students shaped soft clay into interesting animal figures.
2154.zh: 學生們把柔軟的黏土捏成有趣的動物造型。

2154.en: The ancient pot was made of red clay and water.
2154.zh: 這個古老的陶罐是用紅黏土和水製成的。

2156.en: The lawyer carefully discussed the contract with her client.
2156.zh: 律師與她的客戶仔細討論了合約內容。

2156.en: Our company always tries to satisfy every single client.
2156.zh: 我們公司總是努力讓每一位客戶都感到滿意。

2164.en: The loud cock crowed to announce the early morning.
2164.zh: 大聲的公雞啼叫著宣告清晨的到來。

2164.en: Farmers kept a proud cock running around the yard.
2164.zh: 農夫在院子裡養了一隻高傲的公雞跑來跑去。

2165.en: Adults enjoyed chatting while sipping fruit cocktails at the party.
2165.zh: 成年人在派對上邊喝水果雞尾酒邊聊天。

2165.en: The bartender prepared a colorful cocktail for the guest.
2165.zh: 酒保為客人調製了一杯色彩繽紛的雞尾酒。

2166.en: We drank fresh coconut water on the beach.
2166.zh: 我們在海灘上喝了新鮮的椰子水。

2166.en: Coconut oil is very popular for hair care.
2166.zh: 椰子油在護髮方麵非常受歡迎。

2170.en: The artist used colorful paints for the mural.
2170.zh: 這位藝術家用色彩繽紛的顏料來畫壁畫。

2170.en: Colorful flowers bloomed in the school garden.
2170.zh: 色彩鮮豔的花朵在校園花園裡盛開。

2173.en: Don't forget to put a comma after the greeting.
2173.zh: 別忘了在問候語後面加一個逗號。

2173.en: A missing comma can completely change the sentence meaning.
2173.zh: 漏掉一個逗號可能會完全改變句子的意思。

2190.en: He held the game controller tightly in his hands.
2190.zh: 他雙手緊緊握著遊戲控制器。

2190.en: The air traffic controller guided the plane safely.
2190.zh: 空中交通管制員引導飛機安全降落。

2191.en: My mother bought a new electric rice cooker yesterday.
2191.zh: 我媽媽昨天買了一個新的電鍋。

2191.en: A slow cooker is convenient for making beef soup.
2191.zh: 慢燉鍋對於煮牛肉湯來說很方便。

2192.en: Making this mistake would be too costly for us.
2192.zh: 犯這個錯誤對我們來說代價太高了。

2192.en: Buying a new car is a costly decision.
2192.zh: 買新車是一個所費不貲的決定。

2195.en: An apple is a countable noun in English grammar.
2195.zh: 在英文文法中，「蘋果」是一個可數名詞。

2195.en: Can you give me an example of a countable noun?
2195.zh: 你能給我一個可數名詞的例子嗎？

2196.en: They live in a quiet county in southern Taiwan.
2196.zh: 他們住在台灣南部一個安靜的縣。

2196.en: The county government plans to build a new library.
2196.zh: 縣政府計劃建造一座新圖書館。

2214.en: Doctors suggest eating dairy products for strong bones.
2214.zh: 醫生建議多吃乳製品來強健骨骼。

2214.en: Some people cannot digest dairy foods very well.
2214.zh: 有些人無法很好地消化乳製品食物。

2217.en: The mother smiled and called her little girl darling.
2217.zh: 母親微笑着叫她的小女孩「親愛的」。

2217.en: The cute puppy quickly became the darling of the family.
2217.zh: 這隻可愛的小狗很快成了全家人的心肝寶貝。

2221.en: The car dealer offered us a great discount.
2221.zh: 這家汽車經銷商給了我們很大的折扣。

2221.en: Police arrested a local drug dealer last night.
2221.zh: 警方昨晚逮捕了一名當地的販毒者。

2223.en: We sat on the wooden deck to watch the sunset.
2223.zh: 我們坐在木製甲板上欣賞日落。

2223.en: She shuffled a deck of cards before the game.
2223.zh: 她在遊戲開始前洗了一副牌。

2230.en: Taiwan is a free and democratic country.
2230.zh: 台灣是一個自由且民主的國家。

2230.en: The club made decisions through a democratic process.
2230.zh: 這個社團透過民主程序來做決定。

2233.en: Fluency in English is desirable for this job.
2233.zh: 這份工作最好具備流利英語能力。

2233.en: Living near a park is highly desirable.
2233.zh: 住在公園附近是非常理想的。

2241.en: He didn't have a dime to buy lunch.
2241.zh: 他連一毛錢也沒有，買不起午餐。

2241.en: She saved every single dime for her trip.
2241.zh: 她為了旅行存下了每一分錢。

2243.en: Children love looking at dinosaur bones in the museum.
2243.zh: 孩子們喜歡在博物館看恐龍骨頭。

2243.en: Scientists study how dinosaurs became extinct long ago.
2243.zh: 科學家研究恐龍很久以前是如何絕種的。

2247.en: It is dishonest to cheat on the exam.
2247.zh: 考試作弊是不誠實的行為。

2247.en: He lost our trust because he was dishonest.
2247.zh: 他因為不誠實而失去了我們的信任。

2250.en: The car accidentally slipped into a roadside ditch.
2250.zh: 汽車不小心滑進路邊的水溝裡。

2250.en: Some students plan to ditch class this afternoon.
2250.zh: 有些學生計畫今天下午逃學。

2252.en: The spinning rides made the little boy dizzy.
2252.zh: 旋轉遊樂設施讓小男孩感到頭暈。

2252.en: She felt a bit dizzy after standing up quickly.
2252.zh: 她快速站起來後覺得有點頭暈。

2253.en: The large ship slowly pulled into the dock.
2253.zh: 那艘大船緩緩駛入碼頭。

2253.en: Fishermen were busy repairing their nets at the dock.
2253.zh: 漁夫們正忙著在碼頭修補漁網。

2255.en: The farmer used a strong donkey to carry heavy wood.
2255.zh: 農夫用一隻強壯的驢子來搬運重木材。

2255.en: We saw a cute donkey resting under the big tree.
2255.zh: 我們看到一隻可愛的驢子在大樹下休息。

2256.en: The doctor gave me the right dose of medicine.
2256.zh: 醫生給了我正確劑量的藥物。

2256.en: You should not take a higher dose without asking.
2256.zh: 未經詢問，你不應該服用更高的劑量。

2258.en: She bought a sweet chocolate doughnut for her brother.
2258.zh: 她為哥哥買了一個甜甜的巧克力甜甜圈。

2258.en: Eating a hot doughnut makes me feel very happy.
2258.zh: 吃一個熱騰騰的甜甜圈讓我感到非常開心。

2261.en: A colorful dragonfly landed softly on the garden flower.
2261.zh: 一隻色彩繽紛的蜻蜓輕輕停在花園的花朵上。

2261.en: We watched a dragonfly flying quickly over the pond.
2261.zh: 我們看著一隻蜻蜓在池塘上快速飛過。

2270.en: My grandmother makes delicious pork dumpling for dinner.
2270.zh: 我奶奶晚餐做了好吃的豬肉水餃。

2270.en: They ordered a plate of hot dumpling at the restaurant.
2270.zh: 他們在餐廳點了一盤熱騰騰的餃子。

2273.en: My voice made a clear echo in the empty cave.
2273.zh: 我的聲音在空蕩的山洞裡產生了清晰的回音。

2273.en: The loud music seemed to echo through the whole house.
2273.zh: 大聲的音樂似乎在整棟房子裡迴盪。

2285.en: Trust is a key element in a good friendship.
2285.zh: 信任是良好友誼中的一個關鍵要素。

2285.en: Water is an essential element for all living things.
2285.zh: 水是所有生物不可或缺的元素。

2297.en: The school is famous for its academic excellence.
2297.zh: 這所學校以其學術卓越而聞名。

2297.en: He won an award for excellence in computer science.
2297.zh: 他因電腦科學表現優異而獲得獎項。

2305.en: The young actor gave an expressive and touching performance.
2305.zh: 這位年輕演員帶來了富有表現力且感人的表演。

2305.en: Her expressive eyes showed how much she cared.
2305.zh: 她那雙會說話的眼睛表現出她有多麼在意。

2307.en: The bright colors of the old shirt began to fade.
2307.zh: 舊襯衫鮮豔的顏色開始褪色了。

2307.en: The sound of the music slowly faded away.
2307.zh: 音樂的聲音慢慢地漸漸消失了。

2319.en: The little boy was fearful of the dark room.
2319.zh: 小男孩很害怕那間黑暗的房間。

2319.en: She felt fearful about making mistakes during the speech.
2319.zh: 她擔心在演講時會犯錯。

2322.en: He is a true fighter who never gives up.
2322.zh: 他是一位從不放棄的真正的鬥士。

2322.en: The brave firefighter rushed into the burning building.
2322.zh: 這位勇敢的消防員衝進了燃燒中的建築物。

2323.en: We watched the brilliant fireworks light up the night sky.
2323.zh: 我們看著燦爛的煙火照亮了夜空。

2323.en: Setting off fireworks is illegal in this residential area.
2323.zh: 在這個住宅區施放煙火是違法的。

2329.en: Bears have strong teeth and sharp claws to tear flesh.
2329.zh: 熊有強壯的牙齒和銳利的爪子來撕裂血肉。

2329.en: Some mosquitoes feed on the flesh and blood of animals.
2329.zh: 有些蚊子以動物的血肉為食。

2331.en: A large flock of birds flew across the blue sky.
2331.zh: 一大群鳥飛越了藍色的天空。

2331.en: Tourists flock to the night market every weekend.
2331.zh: 每週末遊客如織地湧入夜市。

4974.en: The stray dog became vicious when people got too close.
4974.zh: 當人們靠得太近時，那隻流浪狗變得凶惡。

4974.en: They are trapped in a vicious cycle of poverty and debt.
4974.zh: 他們陷入了貧窮與負債的惡性循環中。

4975.en: The TV show attracted millions of viewers around the world.
4975.zh: 這個電視節目吸引了全球數百萬名觀眾。

4975.en: Viewers can vote for their favorite singers on the app.
4975.zh: 觀眾可以在應用程式上為他們最愛的歌手投票。

4976.en: Everyone is entitled to express their own viewpoint on this.
4976.zh: 每個人都有權對此事表達自己的觀點。

4976.en: We should consider the problem from a different viewpoint.
4976.zh: 我們應該從不同的視角來思考這個問題。

4977.en: Add some olive oil and vinegar to the fresh salad.
4977.zh: 在新鮮沙拉中加入一些橄欖油和醋。

4977.en: She used white vinegar to clean the dirty kitchen floor.
4977.zh: 她用白醋清理骯髒的廚房地板。

4980.en: The singer has amazing vocal skills and great stage presence.
4980.zh: 這位歌手擁有驚人的歌唱技巧與極佳的舞台魅力。

4980.en: He was very vocal about the new school rules.
4980.zh: 他對於新的學校規定表達了非常強烈的意見。

4982.en: The sick child began to vomit after eating bad food.
4982.zh: 生病的小孩吃了壞掉的食物後開始嘔吐。

4982.en: The strong smell of the chemical made him want to vomit.
4982.zh: 化學品的濃烈氣味讓她感到想吐。

4983.en: The school gave each student a meal voucher.
4983.zh: 學校發給每位學生一張餐券。

4983.en: You can exchange this voucher for a free book.
4983.zh: 你可以用這張禮券兌換一本免費的書。

4988.en: Consumers should be wary of online shopping scams.
4988.zh: 消費者應該對網路購物詐騙保持警惕。

4988.en: She was wary of strangers approaching her house.
4988.zh: 她對靠近她家的陌生人戒心很重。

4993.en: John loves spicy food, whereas his sister hates it.
4993.zh: 約翰喜歡吃辣，而他妹妹則討厭辣。

4993.en: Tom passed the exam, whereas David failed.
4993.zh: 湯姆通過了考試，然而大衛卻不及格。

4997.en: They survived in the wilderness for three days.
4997.zh: 他們在荒野中存活了三天。

4997.en: Hiking in the wilderness requires good survival skills.
4997.zh: 在荒野健行需要良好的求生技能。

5001.en: The comedian made a witty remark on stage.
5001.zh: 那位喜劇演員在臺上開了一個機智的玩笑。

5001.en: Her witty response made everyone in the room laugh.
5001.zh: 她機智的回答逗得室內每個人哈哈大笑。

5004.en: Volunteering at the hospital is a worthwhile experience.
5004.zh: 在醫院當志工是一次很有價值的經驗。

5004.en: We found it worthwhile to visit the science museum.
5004.zh: 我們覺得參觀科學博物館很值得。

5008.en: Please do not abbreviate words in your formal essay.
5008.zh: 請勿在你的正式論文中將單字縮寫。

5009.en: All students must abide by the school rules.
5009.zh: 所有學生都必須遵守校規。

5009.en: Drivers should abide by the speed limit signs.
5009.zh: 駕駛人應該遵守速限標誌。

5010.en: The museum exhibits the art of aboriginal people.
5010.zh: 這間博物館展覽原住民的藝術品。

5010.en: Aboriginal tribes have rich cultural traditions and history.
5010.zh: 原住民族群擁有豐富的文化傳統與歷史。

5011.en: Wildflowers abound in the mountains during the spring.
5011.zh: 春天時山裡到處都是野花。

5011.en: Opportunities abound for those who are well prepared.
5011.zh: 機會總是留給準備好的人（機會處處皆是）。

5012.en: Math concepts often involve a high level of abstraction.
5012.zh: 數學概念通常涉及很高的抽象層次。

5012.en: Freedom is a mere abstraction to people in prison.
5012.zh: 對於監獄裡的人來說，自由只是一個抽象概念。

5014.en: She received a scholarship to study at a music academy.
5014.zh: 她獲得獎學金去一所音樂學院進修。

5014.en: The local police academy trains many new officers every year.
5014.zh: 當地警察學校每年訓練許多新警官。

5015.en: She wore a matching scarf as a winter accessory.
5015.zh: 她戴著一條搭配的圍巾作為冬季配件。

5015.en: He was arrested as an accessory to the bank robbery.
5015.zh: 他因涉嫌參與銀行搶案而被捕。

5016.en: The young director won critical acclaim for his first film.
5016.zh: 這位年輕導演的第一部電影贏得了影評人的高度讚譽。

5016.en: Her innovative novel was widely acclaimed by literary critics.
5016.zh: 她那本創新的小說受到了文學評論家們的廣泛讚賞。

5017.en: All school rules must be obeyed in accordance with regulations.
5017.zh: 所有校規都必須依照規定來遵守。

5017.en: The club operates in accordance with democratic principles.
5017.zh: 這個社團是按照民主原則運作的。

5018.en: The weather will change tomorrow, so plan your clothes accordingly.
5018.zh: 明天天氣會變換，所以請相應地規畫你的穿著。

5018.en: Prices went up, and salaries were raised accordingly.
5018.zh: 物價上漲了，薪水也隨之調高。

5022.en: The politician denied every accusation of corruption made against him.
5022.zh: 這位政治人物否認了針對他的每一項貪腐指控。

5022.en: Her serious accusation shocked everyone in the office.
5022.zh: 她嚴厲的指控讓辦公室裡的每個人都感到震驚。

5024.en: Many teenagers suffer from severe acne during puberty.
5024.zh: 許多青少年在青春期時深受嚴重青春痘之苦。

5024.en: Eating too much oily food can sometimes cause acne.
5024.zh: 吃太多油膩食物有時會引起青春痘。

5025.en: The farmer owns a large farm of fifty acres.
5025.zh: 這位農夫擁有一座五十英畝的大農場。

5025.en: They plan to buy an acre of land to build a house.
5025.zh: 他們計畫買一英畝的土地來蓋房子。

5026.en: Polar bears show amazing adaptation to freezing weather.
5026.zh: 北極熊對酷寒的天氣展現了驚人的適應能力。

5026.en: This popular movie is a film adaptation of a classic novel.
5026.zh: 這部熱門電影是一部經典小說的改編電影。

5041.en: The suspect allegedly stole money from the school office.
5041.zh: 嫌疑人據稱從學校辦公室偷了錢。

5041.en: Witnesses allege that the politician accepted a huge bribe.
5041.zh: 目擊者指稱該政客收受了巨額賄賂。

5043.en: The airplane is flying at a very high altitude now.
5043.zh: 飛機現在正在非常高的高度飛行。

5043.en: Climbers often suffer from headaches at high altitudes.
5043.zh: 登山者在高海拔地區經常會頭痛。

5045.en: The teacher rewrote the test question to remove ambiguity.
5045.zh: 老師重寫了考題以消除語意模糊。

5045.en: We must avoid ambiguity in our school report.
5045.zh: 我們在校園報告中必須避免模稜兩可。

5046.en: The singer performed wonderfully amidst loud cheers.
5046.zh: 歌手在巨大的歡呼聲中表現得十分精彩。

5046.en: He remained calm amid the fierce argument.
5046.zh: 在激烈的爭論中，他依然保持冷靜。

5047.en: Microphones are used to amplify our voices during speeches.
5047.zh: 麥克風用於在演講期間放大我們的聲音。

5047.en: Social media can easily amplify false information.
5047.zh: 社群媒體很容易放大錯誤訊息。

5048.en: The teacher used a simple analogy to explain physics.
5048.zh: 老師用了一個簡單的類比來解釋物理。

5048.en: Drawing an analogy helps students understand complex concepts.
5048.zh: 做類比有助於學生理解複雜的概念。

5051.en: Her arrival seemed to animate the quiet classroom.
5051.zh: 她的到來似乎使安靜的教室充滿了活力。

5051.en: Computer artists can animate cartoon characters easily.
5051.zh: 電腦藝術家可以輕鬆地讓卡通角色動起來。

5052.en: He showed great annoyance when his phone broke.
5052.zh: 當他的手機壞掉時，他表現出極大的惱怒。

5052.en: Noise pollution is a major annoyance for city residents.
5052.zh: 噪音污染是都市居民的一大困擾。

5053.en: Students sang the national anthem proudly at the ceremony.
5053.zh: 學生們在典禮上驕傲地唱著國歌。

5053.en: That pop song became an anthem for teenagers worldwide.
5053.zh: 那首流行歌曲成為全球青少年的主題曲。

5054.en: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic for my throat infection.
5054.zh: 醫生開了抗生素治療我的喉嚨感染。

5054.en: Antibiotics cannot kill viruses like the common cold.
5054.zh: 抗生素無法殺死像普通感冒這樣的病毒。

5055.en: The students waited for the exam results with great anticipation.
5055.zh: 學生們懷著高度的期待等待考試成績。

5055.en: She smiled in anticipation of opening her birthday present.
5055.zh: 她帶著期待拆開生日禮物時笑了起來。

5056.en: Do you know the antonym of this difficult English word?
5056.zh: 你知道這個困難英文單字的相反詞嗎？

5056.en: Hot is a common antonym for the word cold.
5056.zh: 「熱」是「冷」這個詞常見的相反詞。

5059.en: He worked as an apprentice chef in a famous restaurant.
5059.zh: 他在一家知名餐廳擔任學徒主廚。

5059.en: The young apprentice learned carpentry skills from his master.
5059.zh: 年輕的學徒向他的師傅學習木工技巧。

5060.en: Can you give me an approximate cost for the repair?
5060.zh: 你可以給我維修的大約費用嗎？

5060.en: The approximate number of people attending the concert was five hundred.
5060.zh: 參加音樂會的大約人數是五百人。

5061.en: She decided to major in archaeology at the university.
5061.zh: 她決定在大學主修考古學。

5061.en: His interest in ancient history led him to study archaeology.
5061.zh: 他對古代歷史的興趣引導他去研究考古學。

5064.en: The hikers began to ascend the steep mountain early this morning.
5064.zh: 登山者今天清晨開始攀登這座陡峭的山。

5064.en: Hot air balloons slowly ascend into the blue morning sky.
5064.zh: 熱氣球緩緩升入藍色的早晨天空中。

5066.en: The evil plot to assassinate the king was discovered just in time.
5066.zh: 刺殺國王的邪惡陰謀剛好及時被發現了。

5066.en: A rebel group tried to assassinate the president last night.
5066.zh: 一個叛亂團體昨晚企圖暗殺總統。

5068.en: Bad friends can easily lead young teenagers astray.
5068.zh: 壞朋友很容易帶壞年輕的青少年。

5068.en: The hikers went astray because they ignored the map signs.
5068.zh: 登山客因為忽略地圖標示而迷失了方向。

5070.en: The astronomer used a powerful telescope to study distant stars.
5070.zh: 這位天文學家使用強力望遠鏡來研究遙遠的星星。

5070.en: A famous astronomer discovered a new planet in our solar system.
5070.zh: 一位著名的天文學家在我們的太陽系發現了一顆新行星。

5072.en: Hard work is necessary if you want to attain your goals.
5072.zh: 如果你想實現目標，努力工作是必要的。

5072.en: She worked hard to attain success in her professional career.
5072.zh: 她努力工作以在職業生涯中獲得成功。

5074.en: The school board decided to audit the student council's budget.
5074.zh: 學校董事會決定審計學生會的預算。

5074.en: He studied hard to pass the difficult tax audit.
5074.zh: 他努力讀書以通過困難的稅務稽核。

5075.en: All students gathered in the school auditorium for the assembly.
5075.zh: 所有學生都聚集在學校禮堂參加朝會。

5075.en: The famous singer will perform in the large auditorium tonight.
5075.zh: 那位知名歌手今晚將在大禮堂表演。

5076.en: Quick action by the driver helped avert a serious accident.
5076.zh: 駕駛的迅速反應有助於避免嚴重的意外。

5076.en: She looked away to avert her eyes from the bright screen.
5076.zh: 她別過頭去，以免眼睛被亮麗的螢幕刺傷。

5079.en: Please rest awhile before you continue your homework.
5079.zh: 在你繼續寫功課之前，請先休息一下。

5079.en: Can you wait for me here awhile?
5079.zh: 你可以我在這裡等一下嗎？

5081.en: Strong leadership is the backbone of any successful team.
5081.zh: 強大的領導力是任何成功團隊的中堅力量。

5081.en: It takes courage and backbone to stand up for justice.
5081.zh: 挺身而出伸張正義需要勇氣與骨氣。

5082.en: The security guard checked my visitor badge at the entrance.
5082.zh: 警衛在入口處檢查了我的訪客識別證。

5082.en: She pinned a pretty silver badge on her school uniform.
5082.zh: 她在制服上別了一個漂亮的銀色徽章。

5083.en: The mayor hosted a grand banquet for the foreign guests.
5083.zh: 市長為外賓舉辦了一場盛大的宴會。

5083.en: We enjoyed delicious food at the wedding banquet last night.
5083.zh: 我們昨晚在婚宴上品嚐了美味的食物。

5084.en: Ancient Romans often regarded neighboring tribes as barbarians.
5084.zh: 古代羅馬人常將鄰近部落視為野蠻人。

5084.en: His rude table manners made him look like a barbarian.
5084.zh: 他粗魯的餐桌禮儀使他看起來像個野蠻人。

5085.en: The deep bass sound from the speakers shook the room.
5085.zh: 喇叭傳出的低音震動了整個房間。

5085.en: He plays the electric bass in our school rock band.
5085.zh: 他在我們學校的搖滾樂團中彈奏電貝斯。

5086.en: Stir the cake batter until it is completely smooth.
5086.zh: 攪拌蛋糕麵糊直到完全滑順為止。

5086.en: The star batter hit a home run to win the game.
5086.zh: 明星打擊手擊出一支全壘打贏得比賽。

5087.en: Students worked together to beautify the school campus.
5087.zh: 學生們一起合作美化校園。

5087.en: Volunteers planted many flowers to beautify the neighborhood.
5087.zh: 志工們種了許多花來美化鄰里。

5088.en: The microwave gave a loud beep when it finished.
5088.zh: 微波爐完成時發出了很大的嗶聲。

5088.en: I heard a quick beep from my cell phone.
5088.zh: 我聽到我的手機傳來一聲急促的嗶聲。

5091.en: The two countries signed a bilateral trade agreement.
5091.zh: 這兩個國家簽署了一項雙邊貿易協定。

5091.en: Bilateral talks failed to resolve the border conflict.
5091.zh: 雙邊會談未能解決邊境衝突。

5092.en: Firefighters struggled to control the fierce blaze downtown.
5092.zh: 消防員努力控制市區的猛烈大火。

5092.en: A sudden blaze destroyed the old wooden barn.
5092.zh: 突發的大火摧毀了那棟老舊木造穀倉。

5095.en: He left a big ink blot on his notebook.
5095.zh: 他在筆記本上留下了一個大墨漬。

5095.en: She used a tissue to blot the spilled coffee.
5095.zh: 她用面紙吸乾灑出來的咖啡。

5096.en: My grandfather is known for his blunt honesty.
5096.zh: 我的爺爺以直言不諱的誠實而聞名。

5096.en: This knife is too blunt to cut the meat.
5096.zh: 這把刀太鈍了，切不動肉。

5099.en: She held the sleeping baby close to her bosom.
5099.zh: 她把睡著的嬰兒緊緊抱在胸前。

5099.en: They have been bosom friends since elementary school.
5099.zh: 他們從小學起就是知心好友。

5100.en: Tall trees line both sides of the wide boulevard.
5100.zh: 高大的樹木排列在寬闊林蔭大道的兩側。

5100.en: We took a pleasant walk down the busy boulevard.
5100.zh: 我們在繁忙的林蔭大道上愉快地散步。

5102.en: Consumers decided to boycott the company over high prices.
5102.zh: 消費者決定抵制這家價格高昂的公司。

5102.en: The workers organized a successful boycott last week.
5102.zh: 工人們上週組織了一次成功的抵制行動。

5103.en: You need to brace yourself for some bad news.
5103.zh: 你得做好心理準備來接受一些壞消息。

5103.en: The dentist put a metal brace on my teeth.
5103.zh: 牙醫在我的牙齒上裝了金屬牙套。

5105.en: The famous professor is known for the breadth of his knowledge.
5105.zh: 這位知名教授以其淵博的知識而聞名。

5105.en: Reading widely can help students increase the breadth of their vocabulary.
5105.zh: 廣泛閱讀有助於學生擴充他們的詞彙量。

5106.en: My mother's car suffered a sudden breakdown on the highway.
5106.zh: 我媽媽的車子在高速公路上突然拋錨了。

5106.en: Lack of communication often leads to a breakdown in relationships.
5106.zh: 缺乏溝通往往會導致人際關係的破裂。

5107.en: Lisa was very sad after her painful breakup with her boyfriend.
5107.zh: 麗莎在與男友痛苦的分手後感到非常難過。

5107.en: The band announced their breakup after ten years of working together.
5107.zh: 該樂團在合作十年後宣佈解散。

5109.en: The endangered species is now on the brink of complete extinction.
5109.zh: 這個瀕危物種目前正處於完全滅絕的邊緣。

5109.en: The two countries were on the brink of a terrible war.
5109.zh: 這兩個國家當時正處於可怕戰爭的邊緣。

5110.en: Traveling abroad is a great way to broaden your horizons.
5110.zh: 出國旅遊是拓展視野的好方法。

5110.en: Reading different types of books can broaden our minds.
5110.zh: 閱讀不同類型的書籍能夠開闊我們的胸襟。

5112.en: My father likes to broil steaks for dinner on weekends.
5112.zh: 我父親喜歡在週末晚餐時烤牛排。

5112.en: The hikers were exhausted under the broiling summer sun.
5112.zh: 登山客在炙熱的夏日陽光下筋疲力盡。

5114.en: Grandma made some warm chicken broth for my cold.
5114.zh: 奶奶為我的感冒煮了一些溫熱的雞湯。

5114.en: The chef added vegetables to the beef broth for better flavor.
5114.zh: 主廚在牛肉高湯中加入了蔬菜以增加風味。

5115.en: The soldiers developed a strong sense of brotherhood during the war.
5115.zh: 士兵們在戰爭期間培養出強烈的手足情誼。

5115.en: The club promotes peace and brotherhood among young people.
5115.zh: 這個社團旨在促進年輕人之間的和平與博愛。

5117.en: The angry citizen argued with the government bureaucrat about the policy.
5117.zh: 這位憤怒的市民就這項政策與政府官員爭論。

5117.en: Bureaucrats often spend too much time on unnecessary paperwork.
5117.zh: 官僚們經常花太多時間在不必要的文書工作上。

5118.en: We can take the new highway to bypass the heavy traffic.
5118.zh: 我們可以走新公路來避開沉重的交通阻塞。

5118.en: The patient had to undergo a heart bypass surgery last week.
5118.zh: 這位病人上週必須接受心臟繞道手術。

5119.en: Many students drink coffee to get enough caffeine for studying.
5119.zh: 許多學生喝咖啡來攝取足夠的咖啡因以應付讀書。

5119.en: Too much caffeine can make you feel nervous and restless.
5119.zh: 攝取過多咖啡因會讓你感到緊張和坐立不安。

5122.en: The superhero wore a red cape while flying in the sky.
5122.zh: 這位超級英雄在空中飛翔時披著紅色的披風。

5122.en: We stood on the green cape and watched the sunset.
5122.zh: 我們站在綠色的海岬上觀賞日落。

5123.en: The doctor told me to take this medicine capsule twice daily.
5123.zh: 醫生告訴我一天服用這顆藥膠囊兩次。

5123.en: Scientists launched a time capsule into space for future aliens.
5123.zh: 科學家將一個時間膠囊發射到太空中給未來的外星人。

5124.en: Please read the caption below the picture to understand more.
5124.zh: 請閱讀圖片下方的說明文字以了解更多。

5124.en: She added a funny caption to her Instagram photo.
5124.zh: 她在自己的 Instagram 照片上加了一句有趣的標題。

5128.en: Protecting the environment is a cardinal rule for our club.
5128.zh: 保護環境是我們社團最重要的原則。

5128.en: A bright red cardinal bird landed on the snowy branch.
5128.zh: 一隻鮮紅的北美紅雀停在積雪的樹枝上。

5129.en: I miss those carefree days when I was in elementary school.
5129.zh: 我很懷念小學時那些無憂無慮的日子。

5129.en: The kids ran around the park with carefree laughter.
5129.zh: 孩子們帶著無憂無慮的笑聲在公園裡跑來跑去。

5130.en: The old school caretaker locked the gates every evening.
5130.zh: 那名學校老管理員每天傍晚都會鎖上大門。

5130.en: She works as a caretaker for stray cats in her neighborhood.
5130.zh: 她在鄰里間擔任流浪貓的照顧者。

5131.en: Mom bought a large carton of fresh milk from the supermarket.
5131.zh: 媽媽從超級市場買了一大盒鮮奶。

5131.en: Please flatten every empty milk carton before recycling.
5131.zh: 回收前請將每一個空的紙牛奶盒壓扁。

5133.en: The car accident caused heavy traffic and one casualty.
5133.zh: 這場車禍造成交通堵塞以及一人傷亡。

5133.en: Rescue teams searched for any casualty after the strong earthquake.
5133.zh: 強震過後，救援團隊搜尋著任何傷亡人員。

5134.en: Climate change could lead to a global ecological catastrophe.
5134.zh: 氣候變遷可能會導致全球生態大災難。

5134.en: Quick action by the government prevented a financial catastrophe.
5134.zh: 政府迅速的行動避免了一場金融災難。

5149.en: You should schedule a health checkup before joining the school club.
5149.zh: 加入學校社團前，你應該安排一次健康檢查。

5149.en: My grandfather goes to the hospital for a routine checkup every month.
5149.zh: 我爺爺每個月都去醫院做例行檢查。

5150.en: The young chemist discovered a new way to clean polluted water.
5150.zh: 這位年輕的化學家發現了一種淨化受污染水的新方法。

5150.en: I need to run to the chemist to buy some cold medicine.
5150.zh: 我需要跑一趟藥局買一些感冒藥。

5152.en: My mother added too much chili to the spicy beef noodles.
5152.zh: 我媽媽在辣牛肉麵裡加了太多辣椒。

5152.en: Some students cannot eat food that contains fresh chili peppers.
5152.zh: 有些學生不能吃含有新鮮辣椒的食物。

5153.en: Scientists study the behavior of the chimpanzee in the dense forest.
5153.zh: 科學家在密林中研究黑猩猩的行為。

5153.en: The smart chimpanzee used a wooden stick to catch insects.
5153.zh: 這隻聰明的黑猩猩用木棍來捕捉昆蟲。

5157.en: Education helps civilize society by teaching people moral values.
5157.zh: 教育透過教導人們道德價值來使社會文明化。

5157.en: Ancient rivers played an important role in how humans were civilized.
5157.zh: 古老的河流在人類如何走向文明的過程中扮演了重要角色。

5158.en: We went to the beach to dig for fresh clams this morning.
5158.zh: 我們今天早上到海灘去挖新鮮的蛤蜊。

5158.en: He remained as quiet as a clam throughout the class discussion.
5158.zh: 在整個課堂討論中，他安靜得像個蛤蜊一樣不發一語。

5159.en: The little girl held her mother's hand with a tight clasp.
5159.zh: 小女孩緊緊地握著她媽媽的手。

5159.en: Please clasp your hands together while making a silent wish.
5159.zh: 許下無聲的願望時，請把雙手合十握在一起。

5160.en: The department store is holding a big winter clearance sale today.
5160.zh: 這家百貨公司今天正在舉辦大型冬季清倉拍賣。

5160.en: The pilot is waiting for flight clearance from the control tower.
5160.zh: 飛行員正在等待塔台的飛航許可。

5161.en: The exciting movie reached its climax in the final ten minutes.
5161.zh: 這部精彩的電影在最後十分鐘達到了最高潮。

5161.en: That dramatic event marked the climax of the political crisis.
5161.zh: 那個戲劇性的事件標誌著政治危機的最高峰。

5162.en: Turn the metal screw clockwise to lock it firmly in place.
5162.zh: 將金屬螺絲順時針轉動以將其牢牢鎖在定位。

5162.en: The students walked clockwise around the playground during PE class.
5162.zh: 體育課時，學生們沿著操場順時針方向走。

5163.en: Scientists successfully created a clone of the endangered animal.
5163.zh: 科學家成功複製了這隻瀕臨絕種的動物。

5163.en: Is this expensive handbag a cheap clone of the original?
5163.zh: 這個昂貴的手提包是原版的廉價山寨貨嗎？

5164.en: The sudden closure of the factory shocked all the workers.
5164.zh: 工廠的突然倒閉讓所有工人都感到震驚。

5164.en: Writing a letter to her old friend brought emotional closure.
5164.zh: 寫信給老朋友為她帶來了情感上的了結。

5165.en: Several environmental groups formed a coalition to fight pollution.
5165.zh: 幾個環保團體組成聯盟來對抗汙染。

5165.en: The ruling party is trying to build a stable coalition government.
5165.zh: 執政黨正試圖建立一個穩定的聯合政府。

5166.en: Typhoons often cause severe damage along the eastern coastline.
5166.zh: 颱風經常對東部海岸線造成嚴重破壞。

5166.en: We enjoyed a wonderful walk along the rocky coastline.
5166.zh: 我們沿著多岩石的海岸線享受了一次美好的散步。

5167.en: The heavy traffic collision blocked the main road for hours.
5167.zh: 這起嚴重車禍堵塞了主要道路數小時。

5167.en: Scientists study the collision of particles in large accelerators.
5167.zh: 科學家在大型加速器中研究粒子的碰撞。

5168.en: Students should avoid colloquial expressions in formal writing.
5168.zh: 學生在正式寫作中應避免使用口語表達。

5168.en: He learned many colloquial phrases while living in Taipei.
5168.zh: 他住在台北時學會了許多口語片語。

5169.en: Astronomers discovered a bright comet moving across the night sky.
5169.zh: 天文學家發現一顆明亮的彗星劃過夜空。

5169.en: This rare comet only passes by the Earth every century.
5169.zh: 這顆罕見的彗星每世紀才經過地球一次。

5170.en: Smartphones have become commonplace among high school students.
5170.zh: 智慧型手機在高中生之間已經變得司空見慣。

5170.en: Remote learning is no longer commonplace after the pandemic ended.
5170.zh: 疫情結束後，遠距教學已不再是普遍現象。

5171.en: Many nations in the British Commonwealth share similar legal systems.
5171.zh: 大英國協的許多國家擁有相似的法律體系。

5171.en: The politician promised to work for the commonwealth of all citizens.
5171.zh: 這位政治人物承諾為所有公民的福祉而努力。

5172.en: Language teachers encourage students to be more communicative in class.
5172.zh: 語言老師鼓勵學生在課堂上多進行溝通互動。

5172.en: My cat is not very communicative when strangers visit our home.
5172.zh: 當陌生人來我們家時，我的貓不是很愛親近人。

5173.en: We made a comparative study of the two smartphones.
5173.zh: 我們對這兩款智慧型手機進行了比較研究。

5173.en: The cost of living here is comparative to Taipei.
5173.zh: 這裡的生活費與台北差不多。

5176.en: Good wine will complement the rich flavor of the steak.
5176.zh: 好酒能襯托出牛排濃郁的風味。

5176.en: Theory and practice are important complements in learning.
5176.zh: 理論與實務是學習中互補的重要元素。

5177.en: She has a healthy complexion after her long vacation.
5177.zh: 她長假過後擁有健康的膚色。

5177.en: The recent scandal changed the political complexion of the country.
5177.zh: 最近的醜聞改變了該國的政治面貌。

5180.en: The library decided to computerize its entire catalog system.
5180.zh: 圖書館決定將整個目錄系統電腦化。

5180.en: Our company will computerize all customer records next month.
5180.zh: 我們公司下個月將把所有客戶記錄電腦化。

5181.en: The soldiers trusted every comrade in their military unit.
5181.zh: 士兵們信任軍事單位中的每一個同袍。

5181.en: They were loyal comrades during their difficult school years.
5181.zh: 他們在艱難的學生時代是忠實的夥伴。

5182.en: The government refused to make any concession to the strikers.
5182.zh: 政府拒絕向罷工者做出任何讓步。

5182.en: We bought cheap snacks at the movie theater concession stand.
5182.zh: 我們在電影院的小賣部買了便宜的零食。

5184.en: Please condense your long report into a short summary.
5184.zh: 請將你的長篇報告濃縮成一份簡短的摘要。

5184.en: Water vapor will condense on the cold glass surface.
5184.zh: 水蒸氣會在冰冷的玻璃表面凝結。

5185.en: Switzerland is a confederation of twenty-six cantons.
5185.zh: 瑞士是一個由二十六個邦組成的邦聯。

5185.en: The trade union formed a confederation to increase bargaining power.
5185.zh: 工會組成了一個聯盟來增加談判籌碼。

5186.en: The congresswoman proposed a new bill to protect the environment.
5186.zh: 這位女議員提出了一項保護環境的新法案。

5186.en: Local residents wrote letters to their congressman about high taxes.
5186.zh: 當地居民就高額稅收寫信給他們的國會議員。

5187.en: The history book describes the Norman conquest of England.
5187.zh: 這本歷史書描述了諾曼人對英格蘭的征服。

5187.en: Space conquest remains a fascinating goal for humankind.
5187.zh: 太空征服對人類而言仍然是一個迷人的目標。

5188.en: The conscientious student always finishes her homework on time.
5188.zh: 這位認真的學生總是按時完成她的作業。

5188.en: Being conscientious helps him avoid making careless mistakes at work.
5188.zh: 做事認真有助於他在工作時避免犯下粗心的錯誤。

5189.en: We must turn off the lights to conserve electricity.
5189.zh: 我們必須隨手關燈以節約用電。

5189.en: The government took strong measures to conserve natural resources.
5189.zh: 政府採取了強有力的措施來保護自然資源。

5190.en: His kind words brought great consolation to the grieving family.
5190.zh: 他親切的話語帶給悲傷的家屬極大的慰藉。

5190.en: Winning second place was small consolation after working so hard.
5190.zh: 在付出這麼多努力後，獲得第二名只是微不足道的安慰。

5192.en: The letter 'b' is a voiced consonant in English.
5192.zh: 字母『b』在英語中是一個有聲子音。

5192.en: Young children often struggle to pronounce difficult consonant clusters.
5192.zh: 幼童經常很難發出困難的子音連綴。

5193.en: The detective uncovered a conspiracy to overthrow the government.
5193.zh: 偵探揭發了一起推翻政府的陰謀。

5193.en: Many people do not believe in the moon landing conspiracy.
5193.zh: 許多人不相信登月陰謀論。

5194.en: The new tax policy remains a point of bitter contention.
5194.zh: 這項新稅收政策仍然是激烈爭論的焦點。

5194.en: Their main contention is that the plan is too costly.
5194.zh: 他們的主要論點是該計畫花費太高。

5195.en: Every contestant showed great talent in the singing competition.
5195.zh: 每位參賽者在歌唱比賽中都展現了極大的才華。

5195.en: The judges asked each contestant a difficult question.
5195.zh: 評審們問了每位參賽者一個困難的問題。

5196.en: The new manager tried to maintain continuity in the office.
5196.zh: 新經理試圖維持辦公室工作的連續性。

5196.en: Good editing ensures narrative continuity throughout the whole film.
5196.zh: 好的剪輯確保了整部電影敘事的連貫性。

5197.en: His actions often contradict what he says to others.
5197.zh: 他的行為經常與他對別人說的話相矛盾。

5197.en: Do not contradict your parents when they give you advice.
5197.zh: 當父母給妳建議時，不要頂嘴反駁。

5198.en: The committee will convene tomorrow morning to discuss the budget.
5198.zh: 委員會將於明天上午開會討論預算。

5198.en: World leaders plan to convene in Geneva next month.
5198.zh: 世界領導人計畫於下個月在日內瓦開會。

5201.en: She keeps all the correspondence from her old friends.
5201.zh: 她保留著所有來自老朋友的書信往來。

5201.en: Email has largely replaced traditional mail for business correspondence.
5201.zh: 電子郵件在很大程度上已取代了傳統的商業信件往来。

5203.en: Many modern cosmetics are not tested on animals anymore.
5203.zh: 許多現代化妝品不再進行動物實驗了。

5203.en: She spends a lot of money on skin care and cosmetics.
5203.zh: 她花了很多錢在保養品和化妝品上。

5204.en: The minister met with his Japanese counterpart in Tokyo.
5204.zh: 這位部長在東京會見了他的日本同級官員。

5204.en: This new computer is faster than its previous counterpart.
5204.zh: 這台新電腦比它上一代的同類產品更快。

5205.en: You can save money using this discount coupon today.
5205.zh: 你今天使用這張折扣券可以省下一些錢。

5205.en: She collected coupons from the newspaper to buy groceries.
5205.zh: 她從報紙上收集折價券來買日常用品。

5206.en: Students love to chat in the shaded school courtyard.
5206.zh: 學生們很喜歡在有樹蔭的校園中庭聊天。

5206.en: The old temple features a beautiful and quiet central courtyard.
5206.zh: 這座古廟擁有一個美麗且安靜的中央庭院。

5209.en: The police launched a strict crackdown on drunk driving.
5209.zh: 警方對酒駕展開了嚴格的取締行動。

5209.en: This new law marks a major crackdown on illegal drugs.
5209.zh: 這項新法律標誌著對非法毒品的重大打擊。

5210.en: He likes to eat cheese spread on salty crackers.
5210.zh: 他喜歡把起司醬抹在鹹餅乾上吃。

5210.en: The hungry boy finished a whole box of crackers quickly.
5210.zh: 這個飢餓的男孩迅速吃完了一整盒蘇打餅乾。

5214.en: The witness provided credible evidence in court today.
5214.zh: 這位證人今天在法庭上提供了可信的證據。

5214.en: We need a more credible plan to solve this problem.
5214.zh: 我們需要一個更具可信度的計畫來解決這個問題。

5215.en: Giant crocodiles live in the muddy rivers of Australia.
5215.zh: 巨大的鱷魚棲息在澳洲混濁的河流中。

5215.en: Visitors must stay away from the crocodile enclosure.
5215.zh: 遊客必須遠離鱷魚的封閉展示區。

5217.en: He had to walk on crutches after the sports injury.
5217.zh: 他在運動受傷後不得不靠拐杖走路。

5217.en: She used a crutch to support her injured leg.
5217.zh: 她用一支拐杖來支撐受傷的腿。

5219.en: She added some fresh cucumber slices to her green salad.
5219.zh: 她在綠沙拉裡加了一些新鮮的小黃瓜片。

5219.en: Eating a cold cucumber helps us beat the summer heat.
5219.zh: 吃根冰涼的小黃瓜有助於我們對抗夏日暑氣。

5220.en: Teachers try to cultivate good reading habits in students.
5220.zh: 老師們試圖在學生身上培養良好的閱讀習慣。

5220.en: Farmers cultivate various vegetables in this fertile valley.
5220.zh: 農夫們在這個肥沃的山谷中耕種各種蔬菜。

5221.en: The cumulative effect of smoking can lead to serious diseases.
5221.zh: 抽菸的累積效應可能會導致嚴重的疾病。

5221.en: Her cumulative score was high enough to win the prize.
5221.zh: 她累積的分數高到足以贏得獎品。

5222.en: The government took strict measures to curb air pollution.
5222.zh: 政府採取了嚴格的措施來抑制空氣污染。

5222.en: He parked his car safely next to the concrete curb.
5222.zh: 他把車子安全地停在水泥路緣旁。

5223.en: Teenagers should always respect their parents' evening curfew.
5223.zh: 青少年應該隨時遵守父母訂定的晚歸宵禁時間。

5223.en: The city announced a strict curfew during the riot.
5223.zh: 該城市在暴動期間宣布實施嚴格的宵禁。

5225.en: It is customary to tip waiters in local restaurants.
5225.zh: 在當地餐廳給服務生小費是合乎習俗的。

5225.en: She wore her customary smile throughout the difficult meeting.
5225.zh: 她在艱難的會議中一直保持著她慣常的微笑。

5227.en: The brilliant fireworks will dazzle the cheering crowd tonight.
5227.zh: 燦爛的煙火今晚將讓歡呼的人群目眩神迷。

5227.en: Her amazing piano performance managed to dazzle the judges.
5227.zh: 她驚人的鋼琴表演成功驚豔了評審們。

5229.en: This crucial match will play a decisive role in the tournament.
5229.zh: 這場關鍵比賽將在錦標賽中扮演決定性的角色。

5229.en: A good leader must be decisive in times of crisis.
5229.zh: 優秀的領導者在危機時刻必須果斷。

5231.en: The boss will deduct tax from your monthly salary.
5231.zh: 老闆會從你的月薪中扣除稅金。

5231.en: They will deduct points if you submit the report late.
5231.zh: 如果你遲交報告，他們會扣分。

5232.en: You can take any action you deem necessary right now.
5232.zh: 你現在可以採取任何你認為必要的行動。

5232.en: The committee did not deem the proposal practical enough.
5232.zh: 委員會認為該提案不夠實際。

5233.en: The computer will use the default setting for this program.
5233.zh: 這台電腦將會使用這個程式的預設設定。

5233.en: He failed to pay his loan and was in default.
5233.zh: 他未能償還貸款而陷入違約狀態。

5235.en: The students showed open defiance against the unfair school rules.
5235.zh: 學生們表現出對不公校規的公開蔑視。

5235.en: She acted in defiance of her parents' strict wishes.
5235.zh: 她公然違抗父母嚴格的期望而行事。

5237.en: Regular dental checkups are important for healthy teeth.
5237.zh: 定期牙科檢查對擁有健康的牙齒很重要。

5237.en: My company provides good medical and dental insurance.
5237.zh: 我的公司提供很好的醫療與牙科保險。

5238.en: Overfishing will quickly deplete the ocean's fish resources.
5238.zh: 過度捕撈將會迅速耗盡海洋的魚類資源。

5238.en: Heavy work can easily deplete your energy and focus.
5238.zh: 繁重的工作很容易耗盡你的精力和專注力。

5240.en: The mountain climbers began their dangerous descent before sunset.
5240.zh: 登山者們在日落前開始了他們危險的下山行程。

5240.en: She is a young artist of Taiwanese descent.
5240.zh: 她是一位具有台灣血統的年輕藝術家。

5242.en: They are destined to become great leaders in the future.
5242.zh: 他們注定未來會成為偉大的領導者。

5242.en: This letter was destined for you, but it got lost.
5242.zh: 這封信原本是要給你的，但卻寄丟了。

5243.en: Please detach the coupon at the bottom of the page.
5243.zh: 請把頁面底部的折價券撕下來。

5243.en: You can detach the keyboard from this new tablet.
5243.zh: 你可以把鍵盤從這台新平板電腦上拆下來。

5352.en: The shark used its powerful fin to swim fast in the ocean.
5352.zh: 鯊魚利用強壯的魚鰭在海中快速游動。

5352.en: Scuba divers wear special fins to move easily underwater.
5352.zh: 水肺潛水員穿著特殊的蛙鞋以便在水下輕鬆移動。

5353.en: Earth has finite resources, so we must protect the environment.
5353.zh: 地球的資源是有限的，所以我們必須保護環境。

5353.en: Students only have a finite amount of time to finish the exam.
5353.zh: 學生們只有有限的時間來完成考試。

5354.en: Children love to light red firecrackers during the Lunar New Year.
5354.zh: 孩子們喜歡在農曆新年期間點燃紅色的鞭炮。

5354.en: The loud sound of the firecracker scared the stray dog away.
5354.zh: 鞭炮巨大的聲響把流浪狗嚇跑了。

5355.en: Important documents should be kept in a fireproof safe.
5355.zh: 重要的文件應該放在防火保險箱裡。

5355.en: The modern building was constructed with fireproof materials.
5355.zh: 這棟現代建築是用防火材料建造的。

5356.en: Many local villagers make a living by working in the fishery.
5356.zh: 許多當地村民靠在漁場工作謀生。

5356.en: The government is taking new steps to protect the local fishery.
5356.zh: 政府正在採取新的措施來保護當地漁業。

5357.en: A tiny snowflake landed gently on the tip of her nose.
5357.zh: 一片小雪花輕輕落在她的鼻尖上。

5357.en: He likes to eat cereal with milk and sugar every morning.
5357.zh: 他喜歡每天早上吃加了牛奶和糖的穀片。

5361.en: The two rival teams turned from bitter foes into good friends.
5361.zh: 這兩支競爭激烈的隊伍從死敵變成了好朋友。

5361.en: Ignorance is often a greater foe than poverty in society.
5361.zh: 在社會中，無知往往比貧窮是更大的敵人。

5363.en: Our school basketball team faces a formidable opponent tomorrow.
5363.zh: 我們學校的籃球隊明天將面對一個強大的對手。

5363.en: Learning a new foreign language can be a formidable task.
5363.zh: 學習一門新的外國語言可能是一項艱鉅的任務。

5364.en: Scientists tried to formulate a plan to reduce pollution.
5364.zh: 科學家們試圖擬定一項減少汙染的計畫。

5364.en: The student failed to formulate a clear argument.
5364.zh: 這名學生無法構思出一個清晰的論點。

5366.en: Students are preparing for the forthcoming final exams.
5366.zh: 學生們正在準備即將到來的期末考。

5366.en: More details about the event will be forthcoming.
5366.zh: 關於該活動的更多細節隨後就會公佈。

5368.en: The farmer raises various kinds of fowl on the farm.
5368.zh: 這名農夫在農場裡飼養了各種家禽。

5368.en: Wild fowl migrate south before the cold winter arrives.
5368.zh: 野生禽鳥在寒冬到來之前會向南遷徙。

5369.en: He suffered a leg fracture during the soccer game.
5369.zh: 他在踢足球時遭遇了腿部骨折。

5369.en: The heavy fall could fracture the delicate glass.
5369.zh: 重重的摔落可能會使這塊精緻的玻璃碎裂。

5371.en: The garden is filled with fragrant flowers in spring.
5371.zh: 春天時，花園裡充滿了芬芳的花朵。

5371.en: She enjoyed a cup of hot, fragrant black tea.
5371.zh: 她享用了一杯溫熱且香氣四溢的紅茶。

5372.en: Parents made a frantic search for the lost child.
5372.zh: 父母瘋狂地尋找那名走失的小孩。

5372.en: The office was frantic before the project deadline.
5372.zh: 專案截止日期前，辦公室裡一片忙亂。

5373.en: An unexpected freak storm ruined our weekend trip.
5373.zh: 一場突如其來的怪異暴風雨毀了我們的週末旅行。

5373.en: He is a computer freak who loves coding games.
5373.zh: 他是一個熱愛編寫遊戲程式的電腦狂熱者。

5374.en: Heavy traffic on the freeway caused a major delay.
5374.zh: 高速公路上的嚴重交通堵塞造成了重大延誤。

5374.en: Drivers should always wear seatbelts on the freeway.
5374.zh: 駕駛人在高速公路上應隨時繫好安全帶。

5375.en: Oil can reduce the friction between moving machine parts.
5375.zh: 機油可以減少活動機械零件之間的摩擦力。

5375.en: Different opinions caused friction among team members.
5375.zh: 不同的意見在團隊成員之間造成了摩擦。

5376.en: Toxic fumes from factories pollute the city air.
5376.zh: 工廠的有毒廢氣汙染了城市的空氣。

5376.en: He left the office in a fume of anger.
5376.zh: 他帶著滿腔怒火離開了辦公室。

5377.en: The coach could not hide his fury after the bad game.
5377.zh: 那場糟糕的比賽過後，教練無法掩飾他的憤怒。

5377.en: She faced the sudden storm with unexpected fury and strength.
5377.zh: 她以意想不到的狂怒與力量迎向突如其來的暴風雨。

5378.en: A short circuit in the kitchen blew the main fuse.
5378.zh: 廚房的短路燒斷了總保險絲。

5378.en: The two small tech companies decided to fuse into one.
5378.zh: 這兩家小型科技公司決定合併為一家。

5379.en: The teacher told us not to make a fuss over nothing.
5379.zh: 老師告訴我們不要小題大作。

5379.en: Parents always fuss about their children's daily diet.
5379.zh: 父母總是對孩子的日常飲食大驚小怪。

5380.en: The brown horse began to gallop across the green field.
5380.zh: 那匹棕色的馬開始在綠色的田野上奔馳。

5380.en: He watched the majestic animal gallop into the distance.
5380.zh: 他看著那隻雄偉的動物奔跑著遠去。

5381.en: The police finally caught the notorious gangster in the city.
5381.zh: 警方終於在城裡抓到了那個惡名昭彰的歹徒。

5381.en: He used to be a gangster before turning his life around.
5381.zh: 他在痛改前非之前曾是一名幫派份子。

5385.en: Taiwan has unique geographical features due to its location.
5385.zh: 台灣由於其地理位置而擁有獨特的地理特徵。

5385.en: We studied the geographical boundaries between the two countries.
5385.zh: 我們研究了這兩個國家之間的地理界線。

5386.en: I find it difficult to solve this geometry problem.
5386.zh: 我覺得要解出這道幾何題目很困難。

5386.en: High school geometry helps students improve their logical thinking.
5386.zh: 高中幾何有助於學生提升邏輯思考能力。

5387.en: Global warming is causing the mountain glacier to melt fast.
5387.zh: 全球暖化正導致山區冰河快速融化。

5387.en: Scientists study ancient ice cores drilled from the glacier.
5387.zh: 科學家研究從冰河中鑽取出的古代冰心。

5389.en: Many young people are attracted by the glamour of movie stars.
5389.zh: 許多青年都被電影明星的魅力所吸引。

5389.en: She decided to leave the glamour of the fashion industry.
5389.zh: 她決定離開時尚界的光鮮亮麗。

5390.en: A gleam of hope appeared when the rescue team arrived.
5390.zh: 當救援隊抵達時，出現了一絲希望的光芒。

5390.en: The wet pavement began to gleam under the streetlights.
5390.zh: 溼漉漉的人行道在路燈下開始閃閃發光。

5391.en: The swans glide across the calm lake during sunset.
5391.zh: 天鵝在日落時分滑行游過平靜的湖面。

5391.en: Skaters glide gracefully on the ice rink in winter.
5391.zh: 溜冰者冬天在溜冰場上優雅地滑行。

5393.en: His sudden departure brought a sense of gloom to us.
5393.zh: 他突然的離開為我們帶來了一陣憂鬱。

5393.en: The gloomy weather made everyone feel tired and sleepy.
5393.zh: 陰暗的天氣讓每個人都覺得疲倦想睡。

5394.en: The talented goalkeeper saved three penalty shots today.
5394.zh: 這位才華洋溢的守門員今天撲救了三次罰球。

5394.en: Our goalkeeper played brilliantly throughout the soccer match.
5394.zh: 我們的守門員整場足球賽都表現得非常精彩。

5395.en: The company donated books to show its goodwill.
5395.zh: 這家公司捐贈書籍以展現其善意。

5395.en: This international event helps build goodwill between nations.
5395.zh: 這個國際活動有助於建立國家間的友好情誼。

5396.en: Mountain gorillas live in the dense forests of Africa.
5396.zh: 山地大猩猩生活在非洲的密林中。

5396.en: We saw a giant gorilla eating bamboo leaves today.
5396.zh: 我們今天看到一隻巨大猩猩在吃竹葉。

5397.en: She loves listening to traditional gospel music on Sundays.
5397.zh: 她喜歡在星期天聼傳統的福音音樂。

5397.en: Not everything you read on the internet is the gospel.
5397.zh: 你在網路上讀到的每件事不見得都是絕對真理。

5399.en: Cows graze peacefully on the green hills of Taiwan.
5399.zh: 牛群在台灣翠綠的山丘上平靜地吃草。

5399.en: The falling stone only managed to graze his left shoulder.
5399.zh: 掉落的石頭剛好擦傷了他的左肩膀。

5400.en: You need some grease to fix that squeaky bicycle chain.
5400.zh: 你需要一些潤滑油來修理那條會發出聲音的腳踏車鏈條。

5400.en: Use warm water to remove grease from the frying pan.
5400.zh: 用溫水來清除平底鍋上的油垢。

5403.en: Students always grumble about having too much homework.
5403.zh: 學生總是抱怨有太多的家庭作業。

5403.en: He did the chores without a single grumble today.
5403.zh: 他今天做家事連一句怨言都沒有。

5404.en: The skilled hacker stole important data from the company.
5404.zh: 這名技術純熟的駭客從公司偷走了重要資料。

5404.en: Banks use advanced security systems to stop online hackers.
5404.zh: 銀行使用先進的安全系統來阻止網路駭客。

5406.en: Heavy rain might hamper our outdoor school sports day tomorrow.
5406.zh: 大雨可能會妨礙我們明天的戶外學校運動會。

5406.en: Lack of sleep can seriously hamper students' learning efficiency.
5406.zh: 缺乏睡眠會嚴重妨礙學生的學習效率。

5407.en: Poor eyesight can be a handicap for playing certain sports.
5407.zh: 視力不好可能是從事某些運動的不利條件。

5407.en: His lack of experience did not handicap him during the interview.
5407.zh: 他缺乏經驗並沒有在面試時成為他的劣勢。

5408.en: The local market sells various beautiful bamboo handicrafts.
5408.zh: 當地市場販售各種美麗的竹製手工藝品。

5408.en: Students learned traditional handicraft skills in art class today.
5408.zh: 學生們今天在美術課上學習傳統的手工藝技巧。

5409.en: Online bullies often harass teenagers through social media platforms.
5409.zh: 網路霸凌者經常透過社群媒體平台騷擾青少年。

5409.en: The stray dog tried to harass people walking past the alley.
5409.zh: 這隻流浪狗試圖騷擾走過巷子的人們。

5410.en: Leave the clay outside to harden in the warm sun.
5410.zh: 把黏土放在外面，讓它在溫暖的陽光下變硬。

5410.en: Difficult experiences can sometimes harden a person's character.
5410.zh: 艱難的經歷有時會使一個人的性格變得堅強。

5411.en: My grandfather plays the harmonica very well at family gatherings.
5411.zh: 我爺爺在家庭聚會上口琴吹得非常好。

5411.en: He carried a small harmonica in his school backpack.
5411.zh: 他隨身在學校背包裡帶了一支小口琴。

5415.en: Eating more fresh vegetables is healthful for your body.
5415.zh: 多吃新鮮蔬菜對你的身體有益健康。

5415.en: A healthful lifestyle helps reduce stress among high school students.
5415.zh: 健康的生活方式有助於減少高中生的壓力。

5416.en: We enjoyed a hearty meal after the long mountain hike.
5416.zh: 在漫長的山區健行後，我們享用了一頓豐盛的餐點。

5416.en: The teacher gave the winning team a hearty round of applause.
5416.zh: 老師給獲勝的隊伍熱烈的掌聲。

5418.en: The new security measures heighten safety around the campus.
5418.zh: 新的安檢措施提高了校園周邊的安全性。

5418.en: Sad music can heighten the emotional impact of the movie.
5418.zh: 悲傷的音樂可以加強電影的情感衝擊。

5421.en: Police officers arrested a drug dealer smuggling illegal heroin.
5421.zh: 警員逮捕了一名走私非法海洛因的毒販。

5421.en: Educational programs warn teenagers about the serious dangers of heroin.
5421.zh: 教育宣導告誡青少年海洛因的嚴重危害。

5422.en: The survey includes both heterosexual and homosexual couples.
5422.zh: 這項調查包含異性戀與同性戀伴侶。

5422.en: Society should treat heterosexual people and minority groups equally.
5422.zh: 社會應該平等对待異性戀者與少數群體。

5423.en: New employees must respect the corporate hierarchy.
5423.zh: 新員工必須尊重公司的階級制度。

5423.en: She wants to break the traditional social hierarchy.
5423.zh: 她想要打破傳統的社會階級。

5424.en: Terrorists tried to hijack the plane to another country.
5424.zh: 恐怖分子試圖劫持飛機到另一個國家。

5424.en: Hackers can hijack your computer system easily.
5424.zh: 駭客可以輕易地入侵並劫持你的電腦系統。

5426.en: Taiwan became the first Asian country to legalize homosexual marriage.
5426.zh: 台灣成為亞洲第一個將同性婚姻合法化的國家。

5426.en: Homosexual rights have made great progress recently.
5426.zh: 同性戀權益最近取得了很大的進展。

5427.en: The famous scientist received an honorary degree today.
5427.zh: 這位著名科學家今天獲得了一項榮譽學位。

5427.en: She was appointed as the honorary chair of the club.
5427.zh: 她被任命為該俱樂部的榮譽主席。

5428.en: Local residents were very hospitable to foreign travelers.
5428.zh: 當地居民對外國旅客非常熱情好客。

5428.en: Taiwanese people are known for being warm and hospitable.
5428.zh: 台灣人以溫暖好客而聞名。

5432.en: A helicopter hovered above the burning building.
5432.zh: 一架直升機在燃燒的建築物上方盤旋。

5432.en: The temperature hovered around thirty degrees all day.
5432.zh: 氣溫整天都在三十度左右徘徊。

5435.en: Financial problems are the biggest hurdle for our project.
5435.zh: 財務問題是我們專案最大的障礙。

5435.en: He jumped over the final hurdle to win gold.
5435.zh: 他跨過最後一個欄架贏得了金牌。

5436.en: Many people prefer driving hybrid cars to save gas.
5436.zh: 許多人為了省油而偏好開油電混合車。

5436.en: The school now offers a hybrid learning environment.
5436.zh: 這所學校現在提供混合式的學習環境。

5438.en: He is a hypocrite who never keeps his promises.
5438.zh: 他是一個從不守信用的偽君子。

5438.en: Don't be a hypocrite by saying one thing and doing another.
5438.zh: 不要嘴上一套做一套，當個雙面人。

5439.en: The titanic ship sank after hitting a massive iceberg.
5439.zh: 那艘巨大的船隻撞上巨大的冰山後沉沒了。

5439.en: This problem is just the tip of the iceberg.
5439.zh: 這個問題只是冰山一角而已。

5441.en: Dark clouds indicate that a heavy rain is imminent.
5441.zh: 烏雲密布顯示大雨即將來臨。

5441.en: The company announced its imminent closure due to debts.
5441.zh: 由於負債，該公司宣布即將倒閉。

5444.en: There was an implicit agreement between the two friends.
5444.zh: 這兩個朋友之間有一種不言而喻的默契。

5444.en: Her words carried an implicit warning to everyone.
5444.zh: 她說的話對每個人帶有含蓄的警告。

5446.en: The corrupt official was imprisoned for ten years.
5446.zh: 這名貪腐官員被判入獄十年。

5446.en: They tried to imprison the innocent man wrongfully.
5446.zh: 他們企圖誣陷並將這名無辜男子關進監獄。

5447.en: I incline to believe her explanation of the event.
5447.zh: 我傾向於相信她對這起事件的解釋。

5447.en: The steep incline made it difficult to ride uphill.
5447.zh: 這道陡坡讓人很難騎車上山。

5448.en: The school promotes a more inclusive learning environment.
5448.zh: 學校提倡更具包容性的學習環境。

5448.en: The price is inclusive of breakfast and free Wi-Fi.
5448.zh: 這個價格包含早餐和免費無線網路。

5451.en: Residents were indignant about the sudden tax increase.
5451.zh: 居民對突如其來的稅收增加感到憤慨。

5451.en: She felt indignant when her ideas were completely ignored.
5451.zh: 當她的想法完全被忽視時，她感到非常憤怒。

5452.en: Certain foods can induce severe allergic reactions.
5452.zh: 某些食物會引發嚴重的過敏反應。

5452.en: The doctor tried to induce sleep with medication.
5452.zh: 醫生試圖用藥物來誘導睡眠。

5453.en: Many developing countries strive to industrialize rapidly.
5453.zh: 許多發展中國家努力快速實現工業化。

5453.en: The small farming town has industrialized over decades.
5453.zh: 這個小農村經過幾十年已經工業化了。

5456.en: Natural disasters inflict heavy losses on local farmers.
5456.zh: 自然災害對當地農民造成了沉重的損失。

5456.en: Bullying can inflict deep emotional scars on teenagers.
5456.zh: 霸凌會對青少年造成深刻的情感創傷。

5458.en: Every inhabitant of this small village loves the quiet lifestyle.
5458.zh: 這個小村莊的每位居民都喜愛這種安靜的生活方式。

5458.en: Local inhabitants protested against the new factory construction plan.
5458.zh: 當地居民抗議這項新工廠建設計畫。

5459.en: We must fight against social injustice and racial discrimination.
5459.zh: 我們必須對抗社會不公與種族歧視。

5459.en: She could not bear to see such an injustice happen.
5459.zh: 她無法忍受看到這樣的不公義的事情發生。

5460.en: The strong typhoon moved inland and brought heavy rain.
5460.zh: 強烈颱風向內陸移動並帶來豪雨。

5460.en: They traveled to an inland city for their summer vacation.
5460.zh: 他們暑假前往一座內陸城市旅行。

5461.en: Students face innumerable challenges during their high school years.
5461.zh: 高中生在求學期間面臨無數的挑戰。

5461.en: She has read innumerable books about ancient history.
5461.zh: 她已經讀過無數本關於古代歷史的書籍。

5462.en: You can call the service desk to inquire about flight times.
5462.zh: 你可以打服務台電話詢問航班時間。

5462.en: He walked to the counter to inquire about the ticket prices.

5463.en: The project succeeded thanks to her strong insistence on quality.
5463.zh: 由於她對品質的堅決堅持，該專案成功了。

5463.en: Despite our objections, he went ahead at his own insistence.
5463.zh: 儘管我們反對，他在自己的堅持下還是做了。

5464.en: Closing eyes in bright light is an instinctive reaction.
5464.zh: 在強光下閉上眼睛是一種本能反應。

5464.en: His instinctive response saved the child from danger.
5464.zh: 他的本能反應救了那名脫險的孩子。

5466.en: Albert Einstein was a man of extraordinary intellect.
5466.zh: 愛因斯坦是個具有非凡才智的人。

5466.en: Reading good books helps develop our mind and intellect.
5466.zh: 閱讀好書有助於發展我們的頭腦與才智。

5470.en: Trust and honesty are important for intimacy in friendship.
5470.zh: 信任與誠實對友誼中的親密感很重要。

5470.en: They shared a rare moment of emotional intimacy last night.
5470.zh: 他們昨晚分享了一個難得的情感親密時刻。
