5968.zh: 身為一位多才多藝的演員，他能把許多不同的角色都演好。

5970.en: The president decided to veto the new environmental protection bill.
5970.zh: 總統決定對這項新的環境保護法案行使否決權。

5970.en: Our teacher used her authority to veto the class trip plan.
5970.zh: 我們的老師行使權力否決了班級旅行計畫。

5972.en: The strong vibration of the earthquake scared the students.
5972.zh: 地震的劇烈震動把學生們嚇壞了。

5972.en: I felt a slight vibration from my phone in my pocket.
5972.zh: 我感覺口袋裡的手機有輕微的震動。

5974.en: The proud victor raised his trophy high in the air.
5974.zh: 光榮的勝利者將他的獎盃高高舉起。

5974.en: Every player wants to be the ultimate victor of the game.
5974.zh: 每個球員都想成為這場比賽的最終勝利者。

5975.en: The young athletes played the basketball game with great vigor.
5975.zh: 年輕的運動員們充滿活力地打這場籃球賽。

5975.en: Grandma still exercises every morning to maintain her health and vigor.
5975.zh: 奶奶每天早上仍然運動以保持健康與活力。

5976.en: The teacher suggested doing vigorous exercise for thirty minutes daily.
5976.zh: 老師建議每天進行三十分鐘的劇烈運動。

5976.en: The government launched a vigorous campaign against air pollution.
5976.zh: 政府發起了一場打擊空氣污染的大規模運動。

5977.en: They rented a luxury villa by the sea for their vacation.
5977.zh: 他們租了一棟海邊的豪華別墅來度假。

5977.en: The rich businessman bought a large villa in the countryside.
5977.zh: 那位富商在鄉下買了一棟大別墅。

5978.en: The hero finally defeated the wicked villain in the movie.
5978.zh: 男主角最後在電影中擊敗了邪惡的反派。

5978.en: Everyone in the town hated the villain who stole their money.
5978.zh: 鎮上的每個人都討厭那個偷了他們錢的壞蛋。

5979.en: Green ivy vine covered the old brick wall of the school.
5979.zh: 綠色的長春藤蔓覆蓋了學校老舊的磚牆。

5979.en: Sweet grapes grow on the long green vine in the yard.
5979.zh: 甜美的葡萄長在院子裡綠色的長藤上。

5980.en: The farmers worked hard in the sunny vineyard all day long.
5980.zh: 農夫們一整天都在陽光普照的葡萄園裡努力工作。

5980.en: We visited a famous vineyard and tasted some local red wine.
5980.zh: 我們參觀了一座著名的葡萄園並品嚐了一些當地紅酒。

5981.en: The talented violinist played a beautiful song at the concert.
5981.zh: 這位才華洋溢的小提琴家在音樂會上彈奏了一首動聽的曲子。

5981.en: She wants to be a professional violinist in a big orchestra.
5981.zh: 她想成為大型樂團裡的專業小提琴手。

5982.en: The tourists enjoyed the clean air in the virgin forest.
5982.zh: 遊客們很享受原始森林裡的乾淨空氣。

5982.en: This island remains a virgin land without modern pollution.
5982.zh: 這座島嶼依然是一片沒有現代污染的處女地。

5983.en: The young athletes showed great vitality during the game.
5983.zh: 年輕運動員在比賽中展現了極大的活力。

5983.en: Green plants bring vitality to the living room.
5983.zh: 綠色植物為客廳帶來了生氣。

5984.en: She finally found her true vocation in nursing.
5984.zh: 她終於在護理工作中找到了真正的天職。

5984.en: Choosing a vocation requires careful thought about your future.
5984.zh: 選擇職業需要對你的未來進行深思熟慮。

5985.en: Many students choose to attend vocational high schools.
5985.zh: 許多學生選擇就讀高職。

5985.en: This school offers various vocational training programs.
5985.zh: 這所學校提供各種職業訓練課程。

5986.en: Every English word must contain at least one vowel.
5986.zh: 每個英文單字都必須包含至少一個母音。

5986.en: Can you tell me which letters are vowels?
5986.zh: 你能告訴我哪些字母是母音嗎？

5989.en: The sick children were resting quietly in the hospital ward.
5989.zh: 生病的孩子們安靜地在醫院病房裡休息。

5989.en: The old man was placed in the children's ward.
5989.zh: 這位老人被安置在兒童病房裡。

5990.en: She bought some new clothes to update her winter wardrobe.
5990.zh: 她買了一些新衣服來更新她的冬季衣物。

5990.en: His wooden wardrobe is full of formal suits.
5990.zh: 他的木製衣櫃裡裝滿了正式西裝。

5992.en: The new smartphone comes with a one-year warranty.
5992.zh: 這支新智慧型手機附有一年的保固期。

5992.en: Make sure the warranty covers accidental water damage.
5992.zh: 確保保固範圍包含意外的水損壞。

5994.en: The hikers felt weary after walking for six hours.
5994.zh: 健行者走了六個小時後感到疲憊。

5994.en: She gave a weary sigh after finishing her homework.
5994.zh: 她寫完功課後疲倦地嘆了口氣。

5995.en: Fishing boats were tied securely to the wooden wharf.
5995.zh: 漁船牢牢地繫在木製碼頭上。

5995.en: We watched the big ship slowly approach the wharf.
5995.zh: 我們看著大船緩緩靠近碼頭。

5997.en: The store sells fresh fruit at wholesale prices.
5997.zh: 這家店以批發價販售新鮮水果。

5997.en: They decided to buy the office supplies wholesale.
5997.zh: 他們決定批發購買辦公用品。

5999.en: The elderly widow lives alone in a quiet suburban house.
5999.zh: 那位年邁的寡婦獨自住在安靜的郊區房子裡。

5999.en: The grieving widower visits his wife's grave every Sunday.
5999.zh: 這位哀傷的鰥夫每週日都會去探望妻子的墳墓。

6000.en: Parents should not withhold love and support from their children.
6000.zh: 父母不應該對孩子吝於給予愛與支持。

6000.en: The suspect decided to withhold information from the police officers.
6000.zh: 該嫌疑人決定向警方隱瞞相關資訊。

6001.en: Economic downturns bring much woe to small business owners.
6001.zh: 經濟蕭條給小型企業主帶來了許多悲傷與困境。

6001.en: She listened patiently to her best friend's endless woes.
6001.zh: 她耐心地聽著摯友那說不完的苦惱。

6002.en: A noisy woodpecker was pecking at the old oak tree.
6002.zh: 一隻吵鬧的啄木鳥正在啄那棵老橡樹。

6002.en: We heard a woodpecker searching for insects in the forest.
6002.zh: 我們聽到一隻啄木鳥在森林裡尋找昆蟲。

6003.en: More young women are entering the global workforce today.
6003.zh: 如今有越來越多女性進入全球勞動人口。

6003.en: The company needs to expand its skilled technical workforce.
6003.zh: 這家公司需要擴大其熟練的技術勞動力。

6006.en: Many students yearn for a long summer vacation.
6006.zh: 許多學生都渴望能有一個漫長的暑假。

6006.en: She yearned to travel around the world after graduation.
6006.zh: 她渴望在畢業後去世界各地旅行。

6007.en: Doing yoga every morning helps reduce stress and anxiety.
6007.zh: 每天早晨做瑜伽有助於減輕壓力和焦慮。

6007.en: She joined a local yoga class to improve her flexibility.
6007.zh: 她參加了當地的瑜伽班來改善身體的柔軟度。

6009.en: A sports car just zoomed past us on the highway.
6009.zh: 一台跑車剛剛在高速公路上呼嘯而過。

6009.en: Our English teacher held a class meeting via Zoom.
6009.zh: 我們的英文老師透過 Zoom 舉辦了班級會議。

6014.en: The famous columnist writes about social issues every week.
6014.zh: 這位著名的專欄作家每週都撰寫關於社會議題的文章。

6014.en: Readers eagerly await the new article by their favorite columnist.
6014.zh: 讀者們都熱切期盼他們最喜愛的專欄作家的新文章。

6020.en: Monks have lived in this ancient stone abbey for centuries.
6020.zh: 修士們在這座古老的石造修道院裡生活了數個世紀。

6020.en: Tourists love to visit the beautiful gardens outside the abbey.
6020.zh: 遊客們很喜歡參觀修道院外美麗的花園。

6022.en: The abolition of the old law brought great changes.
6022.zh: 這項舊法的廢除帶來了巨大的改變。

6022.en: Citizens strongly supported the abolition of the death penalty.
6022.zh: 市民們大力支持廢除死刑。

6023.en: The aborigine shared ancient stories with the young students.
6023.zh: 這位原住民與年輕學生們分享了古老的故事。

6023.en: We should respect the culture of every aborigine group.
6023.zh: 我們應該尊重每個原住民群體的文化。

6024.en: She was so absorbing in the novel that time flew.
6024.zh: 她太沉浸在這本小說中了，時間飛逝。

6024.en: The science teacher gave an absorbing lecture today.
6024.zh: 自然老師今天上了一堂引人入勝的課。

6025.en: The rapid acceleration of technology changes our lives daily.
6025.zh: 科技的快速加速每天都在改變我們的生活。

6025.en: The car showed impressive acceleration on the highway.
6025.zh: 這輛車在高速公路上展現了令人印象深刻的加速性能。

6028.en: The band played an acoustic version of their hit song.
6028.zh: 樂團彈奏了他們暢銷曲目的不插電版本。

6028.en: Good acoustic design makes the concert hall sound amazing.
6028.zh: 良好的聲學設計讓音樂廳聽起來非常棒。

6029.en: The farm covers a large acreage of green land.
6029.zh: 這個農場占地廣闊的綠地。

6029.en: They bought the acreage to build a new factory.
6029.zh: 他們買下這片土地來建造一間新工廠。

6030.en: Students must prepare adequately for the difficult exams.
6030.zh: 學生們必須為困難的考試做足充分的準備。

6030.en: The old bridge was not adequately repaired last year.
6030.zh: 這座老舊的橋樑去年並沒有得到充分的修繕。

6032.en: Please write down the adv for each vocabulary word.
6032.zh: 請寫出每個單字的副詞。

6032.en: Teachers often ask students to find the correct adv.
6032.zh: 老師經常要求學生找出正確的副詞。

6034.en: I saw a funny job advert in the newspaper.
6034.zh: 我在報紙上看到一個有趣的求職廣告。

6034.en: That TV advert convinced many people to buy snacks.
6034.zh: 那支電視廣告說服了許多人去買零食。

6036.en: He dreams of working in the aerospace industry someday.
6036.zh: 他夢想著有一天能在航太產業工作。

6036.en: Taiwan has made great progress in aerospace technology.
6036.zh: 台灣在航太科技方面取得了巨大的進展。

6037.en: The hospital is affiliated with a famous medical university.
6037.zh: 這間醫院附屬於一所著名的醫學大學。

6037.en: She works for an organization affiliated with the United Nations.
6037.zh: 她在一個聯合國附屬的組織工作。

6038.en: Many families struggled in the aftermath of the severe earthquake.
6038.zh: 許多家庭在強震過後的餘波中掙扎。

6038.en: The city slowly recovered in the aftermath of the typhoon.
6038.zh: 這座城市在颱風過後緩慢復原。

6040.en: Their aggregate sales exceeded one million dollars this year.
6040.zh: 他們今年的總銷售額超過了一百萬美元。

6040.en: We need to aggregate all the data before analysis.
6040.zh: 我們在分析前需要把所有數據聚集起來。

6043.en: The mayor and his aide arrived at the meeting early.
6043.zh: 市長和他的助理很早就到達會議現場。

6043.en: A presidential aide announced the new policy today.
6043.zh: 一位總統幕僚今天宣布了這項新政策。

6045.en: Please keep the cookies in an air-tight container.
6045.zh: 請把餅乾放在密封容器裡。

6045.en: The police built an air-tight case against the suspect.
6045.zh: 警方針對嫌疑人建立了嚴密無懈可擊的案子。

6046.en: He decided to join the airforce after graduating.
6046.zh: 他畢業後決定加入空軍。

6046.en: The airforce conducted a routine training flight today.
6046.zh: 空軍今天進行了例行訓練飛行。

6048.en: His writing style is akin to that of Hemingway.
6048.zh: 他的寫作風格類似海明威。

6048.en: Failure at this stage is akin to giving up.
6048.zh: 在這個階段失敗形同放棄。

6049.en: The forest fire spread at an alarming speed.
6049.zh: 森林大火以驚人的速度蔓延。

6049.en: There is an alarming increase in plastic waste.
6049.zh: 塑膠垃圾有著令人擔憂的增長。

6050.en: Alas, we missed the last train home.
6050.zh: 唉，我們錯過了回家的末班車。

6050.en: He tried his best, but alas, he failed.
6050.zh: 他盡力了，但唉，他還是失敗了。

6051.en: She finished the report, albeit a bit late.
6051.zh: 她完成了報告，雖然稍微晚了一點。

6051.en: The plan is risky, albeit very profitable.
6051.zh: 這個計畫帶有風險，雖然獲利很高。

6052.en: Modern technology sometimes increases feelings of social alienation among teenagers.
6052.zh: 現代科技有時候會增加青少年之間的社會疏離感。

6052.en: Language barriers can lead to a deep sense of alienation abroad.
6052.zh: 語言障礙可能會在國外導致深刻的疏離感。

6053.en: The politician strongly denied every allegation of corruption against him.
6053.zh: 該政治人物強力否認所有針對他的貪腐指控。

6053.en: Police are currently investigating the serious allegation made by the witness.
6053.zh: 警方目前正在調查證人所提出的嚴重指控。

6055.en: Fair budget allocation is crucial for the development of public education.
6055.zh: 公平的預算分配對公共教育的發展至關重要。

6055.en: The manager announced a new allocation of tasks for our team.
6055.zh: 經理宣佈了我們團隊的新任務分配。

6056.en: Teachers should allot enough time for students to practice speaking.
6056.zh: 老師應該分配足夠的時間讓學生練習口說。

6056.en: Each club member was allotted a specific role for the festival.
6056.zh: 每個社團成員都被分配到慶典中的特定角色。

6057.en: The old building requires major alteration to meet safety standards.
6057.zh: 這棟老舊建築需要大幅改造才能符合安全標準。

6057.en: She made a slight alteration to the dress before the party.
6057.zh: 她在派對前對洋裝做了輕微的修改。

6058.en: We can take the bus, or alternatively, we can ride bikes.
6058.zh: 我們可以搭公車，或者 alternatively（要不），我們也可以騎腳踏車。

6058.en: You can study in the library, or alternatively, stay at home.
6058.zh: 你可以在圖書館讀書，或者也可以待在家裡。

6060.en: The wild animals waited in the tall grass to ambush their prey.
6060.zh: 野生動物在高草叢中等待以伏擊牠們的獵物。

6060.en: The police set up an ambush to catch the dangerous criminal.
6060.zh: 警方佈下埋伏以逮捕這名危險的罪犯。

6062.en: Soldiers checked their weapons and ammunition before entering the battlefield.
6062.zh: 士兵們在進入戰場前檢查了他們的武器和彈藥。

6062.en: The scandal provided the opposition party with political ammunition.
6062.zh: 這起醜聞為在野黨提供了政治攻擊的彈藥。

6063.en: The government granted amnesty to political prisoners last week.
6063.zh: 政府上週對政治犯頒布了特赦令。

6063.en: The library offered a tax amnesty for overdue books this month.
6063.zh: 圖書館本月針對逾期未還的書本提供免罰期。

6065.en: Confucian analects contain valuable wisdom about traditional moral values.
6065.zh: 儒家論語包含了關於傳統道德價值觀的寶貴智慧。

6065.en: Students in Taiwan often read the Analects of Confucius in class.
6065.zh: 台灣的學生經常在課堂上閱讀《論語》。

6066.en: We visited our ancestral home during the summer vacation.
6066.zh: 我們在暑假期間拜訪了我們的祖厝。

6066.en: The tribe still practices its ancestral customs today.
6066.zh: 這個部落今天仍然實行他們的祖傳習俗。

6067.en: The teacher told a funny anecdote to start the class.
6067.zh: 老師講了一個有趣的軼事來開始這堂課。

6067.en: His speech was filled with interesting anecdotes about travel.
6067.zh: 他的演講充滿了關於旅行的有趣趣事。

6068.en: Many anglers wait quietly by the lake for fish.
6068.zh: 許多垂釣者安靜地在湖邊等待魚上鉤。

6068.en: The experienced angler caught a huge salmon this morning.
6068.zh: 這位經驗豐富的釣客今天早上抓到了一隻巨大的鮭魚。

6069.en: The modern building has a very angular design.
6069.zh: 這棟現代建築有著非常多稜角的設計。

6069.en: He has a sharp face with angular features.
6069.zh: 他有一張輪廓分明的清瘦臉龐。

6070.en: Vaccines help our bodies produce antibodies against diseases.
6070.zh: 疫苗幫助我們的身體產生對抗疾病的抗體。

6070.en: Doctors found high levels of antibodies in her blood.
6070.zh: 醫生在她的血液中發現了高濃度的抗體。

6072.en: The reports of animal abuse appal every decent person.
6072.zh: 虐待動物的報導讓每個正派的人都感到震驚。

6072.en: Violence on television can appal young children easily.
6072.zh: 電視上的暴力畫面很容易嚇壞小孩子。

6073.en: They live in appalling conditions without clean water.
6073.zh: 他們生活在沒有乾淨水質的駭人環境中。

6073.en: The driver made an appalling mistake on the highway.
6073.zh: 駕駛在高速公路上犯了個可怕的錯誤。

6074.en: The idea of working abroad sounds very appealing to him.
6074.zh: 到國外工作的想法對他來說聽起來非常吸引人。

6074.en: She offered an appealing solution to the budget problem.
6074.zh: 她為預算問題提出了一個吸引人的解決方案。

6075.en: We ordered garlic bread as an appetizer before dinner.
6075.zh: 我們在晚餐前點了大蒜麵包當作開胃菜。

6075.en: The restaurant serves a free soup as a daily appetizer.
6075.zh: 這家餐廳供應免費的湯品作為每日開胃菜。

6076.en: The bank requires a property appraisal before granting loans.
6076.zh: 銀行在發放貸款前要求進行房產估價。

6076.en: Employees look forward to their annual performance appraisal.
6076.zh: 員工們都很期待他們的年度績效考核。

6077.en: Students felt great apprehension before the final exam.
6077.zh: 學生們在期末考前感到相當不安。

6077.en: Her apprehension grew as she walked into the interview room.
6077.zh: 當她走進面試房間時，她的憂慮越來越深。

6082.en: The museum displays heavy artillery from World War II.
6082.zh: 這座博物館展示了第二次世界大戰的重型火砲。

6082.en: Soldiers moved the artillery pieces to the frontline camp.
6082.zh: 士兵們將火砲搬遷到前線營地。

6083.en: Police tried to ascertain the cause of the fire.
6083.zh: 警方試圖查明火災的原因。

6083.en: We need to ascertain whether the train is on time.
6083.zh: 我們需要確認火車是否準點。

6084.en: People often ascribe success to hard work and luck.
6084.zh: 人們常將成功歸因於努力和運氣。

6084.en: He did not ascribe the failure to bad luck.
6084.zh: 他並沒有將失敗歸咎於運氣不好。

6085.en: Her main aspiration is to become a medical doctor.
6085.zh: 她主要的志向是成為一名醫師。

6085.en: Parents should support their children's educational aspirations.
6085.zh: 父母應該支持孩子的求學抱負。

6086.en: The aspiring writer spent all weekend working on her novel.
6086.zh: 這位有抱負的作家整個週末都在寫小說。

6086.en: Aspiring musicians need to practice their instruments every day.

6309.zh: 來自不同宗教教派的人們參加了這場慈善活動。

6309.en: Please sort the paper money by its denomination.
6309.zh: 請按照紙鈔的面額把錢分類。

6310.en: A red traffic light usually denotes danger or stopping.
6310.zh: 紅色的交通燈通常表示危險或停止。

6310.en: These symbols on the map denote different types of trees.
6310.zh: 地圖上的這些符號代表不同種類的樹木。

6311.en: Citizens gathered in the square to denounce the new policy.
6311.zh: 市民聚集在廣場上譴責這項新政策。

6311.en: The mayor strongly denounced the acts of violence.
6311.zh: 市長強烈譴責暴力行為。

6312.en: The government decided to deport the illegal immigrants immediately.
6312.zh: 政府決定立即驅逐這些非法移民。

6312.en: He faces the risk of being deported back home.
6312.zh: 他面臨被遣返回國的風險。

6313.en: New cars usually depreciate quickly in the first year.
6313.zh: 新車通常在第一年內迅速貶值。

6313.en: Real estate rarely seems to depreciate over a long period.
6313.zh: 房地產在長期來看似乎很少貶值。

6314.en: She is a direct descendant of a famous royal family.
6314.zh: 她是某個著名皇室家族的直系後代。

6314.en: These local people are descendants of early immigrants.
6314.zh: 這些當地人是早期移民的後裔。

6316.en: He gave a despairing look when he failed the test.
6316.zh: 當他考試不及格時，他露出了絕望的表情。

6316.en: The rescue team saved the despairing hikers just in time.
6316.zh: 救援隊及時拯救了那些絕望的登山客。

6319.en: The government decided to devalue its currency to boost exports.
6319.zh: 政府決定讓貨幣貶值以促進出口。

6319.en: Do not devalue your own efforts based on one failure.
6319.zh: 不要因為一次失敗就貶低自己的努力。

6321.en: Any slight deviation from the plan could cause problems.
6321.zh: 對計劃的任何輕微偏離都可能引起問題。

6321.en: Scientists noticed a strange deviation in the temperature data.
6321.zh: 科學家注意到溫度數據中有一個奇怪的偏差。

6323.en: He remains a diehard fan of the local baseball team.
6323.zh: 他依然是當地棒球隊的死忠球迷。

6323.en: Some diehard traditions are hard to change in modern society.
6323.zh: 有些頑固的傳統在現代社會中很難改變。

6324.en: There is a significant wage differential between men and women.
6324.zh: 男女之間存在著顯著的薪資差距。

6324.en: The teacher used a differential approach for different students.
6324.zh: 老師對不同的學生採用了差異化的教學方法。

6325.en: The diffusion of technology changes how people live today.
6325.zh: 科技的傳播改變了人們當今的生活方式。

6325.en: We can study the diffusion of gases in chemistry class.
6325.zh: 我們可以在化學課上研究氣體的擴散現象。

6327.en: Many foreign dignitaries attended the national presidential inauguration.
6327.zh: 許多外國政要出席了國家總統就職典禮。

6327.en: The airport welcomed several visiting dignitaries this morning.
6327.zh: 機場今天上午迎接了几位來訪的政要。

6328.en: You should dilute the fruit juice with some water.
6328.zh: 你應該用水把果汁稀釋一下。

6328.en: Adding too much water will dilute the flavor of soup.
6328.zh: 加入太多水會沖淡湯的味道。

6329.en: Her parents showed clear disapproval of her sudden career change.
6329.zh: 她的父母對她突然轉行表現出明顯的不滿。

6329.en: The teacher shook his head in disapproval during the test.
6329.zh: 考試期間，老師搖頭表示不贊同。

6330.en: It is hard to disbelieve such a reliable news report.
6330.zh: 要人不相信這樣一篇可靠的新聞報導真的很難。

6330.en: The boy tended to disbelieve stories about monsters under beds.
6330.zh: 那個男孩傾向不相信關於床底怪獸的故事。

6332.en: Many teenagers loved dancing to upbeat music at the disco.
6332.zh: 許多青少年喜歡在迪斯可舞廳隨著輕快的音樂跳舞。

6332.en: The old disco style became popular among college students again.
6332.zh: 復古的迪斯可風格再次在大學生之間流行起來。

6333.en: Growing economic discontent led to massive protests in the city.
6333.zh: 日益增加的經濟不滿引發了該市的大規模抗議。

6333.en: Workers expressed deep discontent with the new company policy.
6333.zh: 工人對公司的新政策表達了深深的不滿。

6334.en: Failing the first exam was quite discouraging for the student.
6334.zh: 第一次考試不及格對那名學生來說相當令人沮喪。

6334.en: The rainy weather gave discouraging results for the weekend event.
6334.zh: 下雨天讓週末的活動得到了令人沮喪的結果。

6335.en: The accountant found a strange discrepancy in the financial records.
6335.zh: 會計師在財務記錄中發現了一個奇怪的出入。

6335.en: They tried to explain the discrepancy between the two reports.
6335.zh: 他們試圖解釋兩份報告之間的差異。

6336.en: Students must use their own discretion when choosing online friends.
6336.zh: 學生在選擇網路朋友時必須自行判斷。

6336.en: The manager left the final decision to the team's discretion.
6336.zh: 經理將最後決定權留給團隊自行裁量。

6337.en: The smell coming from the old trash can was truly disgusting.
6337.zh: 從舊垃圾桶散發出來的味道實在令人作嘔。

6337.en: He found it disgusting when people talked with food in mouth.
6337.zh: 他覺得人們嘴裡含著食物說話很令人討厭。

6338.en: Loading the dishwasher after dinner is my nightly chore.
6338.zh: 晚餐後把碗盤放進洗碗機是我每天晚上的家事。

6338.en: We bought a new dishwasher to save time on housework.
6338.zh: 我們買了一台新洗碗機來節省做家事的時間。

6341.en: His disorganized notes made it hard to study for the test.
6341.zh: 他那雜亂無章的筆記讓人很難準備考試。

6341.en: The disorganized project plan caused a lot of trouble today.
6341.zh: 那個雜亂無章的專案計畫今天引發了許多麻煩。

6342.en: The manager decided to dispatch a team to the branch office.
6342.zh: 經理決定派遣一個團隊前往分公司。

6342.en: Rescue teams were quickly dispatched to the earthquake zone.
6342.zh: 救援隊迅速被派遣至地震災區。

6343.en: The teacher tried to dispel all doubts about the upcoming exam.
6343.zh: 老師試圖消除大家對即將到來考試的所有疑慮。

6343.en: She spoke clearly to dispel any rumors among her classmates.
6343.zh: 她說得很清楚，以消除同學們之間的任何謠言。

6344.en: Police used water cannons to disperse the angry crowd.
6344.zh: 警方使用水砲驅散憤怒的人群。

6344.en: The dark clouds began to disperse as the sun came out.
6344.zh: 太陽出來時，烏雲開始散去了。

6345.en: Rising sea levels could displace millions of coastal residents.
6345.zh: 海平面上升可能會使數百万沿海居民流離失所。

6345.en: Advanced technology might eventually displace many traditional human jobs.
6345.zh: 先進科技最終可能會取代許多传统的人类工作。

6349.en: The runner was disqualified for stepping out of his lane.
6349.zh: 這名跑者因為踩出跑道而被取消資格。

6349.en: A serious injury could disqualify him from the Olympic games.
6349.zh: 嚴重的受傷可能會使他失去參加奧運會的資格。

6351.en: Customers expressed strong dissatisfaction with the poor service quality.
6351.zh: 顧客對糟糕的服務品質表達了強烈的不滿。

6351.en: Many workers voiced their dissatisfaction with the new company policy.
6351.zh: 许多員工表達了他們對新公司政策的不滿。

6352.en: The poor movie ending will surely dissatisfy most loyal fans.
6352.zh: 糟糕的電影結局肯定會讓多數忠實影迷感到不滿。

6352.en: Do not let minor failures dissatisfy your passion for learning.
6352.zh: 不要讓微小的失敗減損你學習的熱情。

6353.en: The political dissident was finally released from prison today.
6353.zh: 這位政治異議人士今天終於從監獄被釋放了。

6353.en: Several dissidents gathered outside the government building to protest.
6353.zh: 幾位異議人士聚集在政府大樓外抗議。

6354.en: Her parents tried to dissuade her from dropping out of college.
6354.zh: 她的父母試圖勸阻她不要從大學輟學。

6354.en: Friends failed to dissuade him from making such a risky investment.
6354.zh: 朋友未能勸阻他不要做如此冒險的投資。

6355.en: The old building was distinctively designed by a famous architect.
6355.zh: 這棟老建築是由知名建築師所設計，風格非常獨特。

6355.en: She smiled distinctively when hearing the surprising news.
6355.zh: 聽到這個令人驚訝的消息時，她露出了與眾不同的微笑。

6356.en: Some media reports tend to distort the true facts.
6356.zh: 有些媒體報導往往會扭曲真實的事實。

6356.en: Do not let anger distort your judgment today.
6356.zh: 今天不要讓憤怒扭曲了你的判斷。

6359.en: She works hard as a divorcee to raise her kids.
6359.zh: 她身為離婚婦女，努力工作扶養孩子。

6359.en: The support group helps every divorcee find new hope.
6359.zh: 這個互助團體幫助每位離婚者找到新的希望。

6360.en: His dogmatic attitude makes it hard to discuss things.
6360.zh: 他那教條式的態度讓人很難討論事情。

6360.en: We should avoid dogmatic beliefs in scientific research.
6360.zh: 我們在科學研究中應該避免教條式的信念。

6361.en: Many young people rely on the dole during hard times.
6361.zh: 許多青年在艱難時期依靠失業救濟金生活。

6361.en: The government plans to dole out food to the poor.
6361.zh: 政府計畫將食物發放給窮人。

6364.en: You must follow the correct dosage of this medicine.
6364.zh: 你必須遵守這款藥物的正確劑量。

6364.en: The doctor doubled her dosage to relieve the pain.
6364.zh: 醫生將她的劑量加倍以減輕疼痛。

6365.en: She will doubtless pass the difficult exam with ease.
6365.zh: 她毫無疑問會輕鬆通過這場困難的考試。

6365.en: Doubtless, technology has changed our daily lives completely.
6365.zh: 毫無疑問地，科技已經徹底改變了我們的日常生活。

6366.en: Poor drainage systems caused severe flooding in the city.
6366.zh: 不良的排水系統導致城市發生嚴重淹水。

6366.en: Workers cleaned the street drainage before the typhoon came.
6366.zh: 工人在颱風來臨前清理了街道排水溝。

6367.en: She used heavy curtains to drape the large windows.
6367.zh: 她用厚重的窗簾來覆蓋那扇大窗戶。

6367.en: He draped a warm jacket over her shivering shoulders.
6367.zh: 他把一件暖和的外套披在她顫抖的肩膀上。

6368.en: The main drawback of this plan is high cost.
6368.zh: 這個計畫的主要缺點是成本太高。

6368.en: Every modern technology has both benefits and drawbacks.
6368.zh: 每種現代科技都有其好處與缺點。

6369.en: The school provides special programs for every high school dropout.
6369.zh: 學校為每位高中輟學生提供特別的課程。

6369.en: Being a college dropout did not stop his success.
6369.zh: 身為大學輟學生並沒有阻止他的成功。

6370.en: The old drunkard slept on the bench all night.
6370.zh: 那個老酒鬼在長椅上睡了一整夜。

6370.en: Police arrested the drunkard for causing trouble outside.
6370.zh: 警方逮捕了這個在外面鬧事的酒鬼。

6371.en: The young duke inherited a large castle from his family.
6371.zh: 年輕公爵從家族那裡繼承了一座大城堡。

6371.en: Many people gathered to see the duke arriving today.
6371.zh: 許多人今天聚集在一起看公爵抵達。

6372.en: She is a dutiful daughter who helps her parents daily.
6372.zh: 她是個孝順的女兒，每天幫父母做事。

6372.en: The dutiful soldier obeyed every command without hesitation.
6372.zh: 盡責的士兵毫不猶豫地服從每一道命令。

6373.en: City dwellers often suffer from heavy traffic and noise.
6373.zh: 城市居民經常受交通擁擠與噪音之苦。

6373.en: Every forest dweller knows how to find safe water.
6373.zh: 每個森林居民都知道如何找到安全的水。

6374.en: Workers used dynamite to clear rocks for the road.
6374.zh: 工人們用炸藥清除道路上的石頭。

6374.en: Handling dynamite requires extreme caution and professional training.
6374.zh: 處理炸藥需要極度小心與專業訓練。

6375.en: Please send your report via e-mail by tomorrow afternoon.
6375.zh: 請在明天下午前透過電子郵件寄出你的報告。

6375.en: I received an important e-mail from the university admissions.
6375.zh: 我收到了大學招生處的一封重要電子郵件。

6377.en: Her monthly earnings are enough to pay the rent.
6377.zh: 她每個月的收入足以支付房租。

6377.en: The company reported high earnings in the third quarter.
6377.zh: 該公司公佈了第三季的高額盈餘。

6378.en: He wore earplugs to block out the loud noise.
6378.zh: 他戴上耳塞來隔絕巨大的噪音。

6378.en: Using earplugs can help you sleep better on planes.
6378.zh: 使用耳塞可以幫助你在飛機上睡得更好。

6380.en: Children love to hunt for Easter eggs in spring.
6380.zh: 孩子們喜歡在春天尋找復活節彩蛋。

6380.en: We usually visit our grandparents during the Easter holiday.
6380.zh: 我們通常在復活節假期去探望祖父母。

6381.en: The strong wind blew the clouds slowly eastwards.
6381.zh: 強風將雲朵緩緩吹向東方。

6381.en: They drove eastwards to watch the sunrise at coast.
6381.zh: 他們開車向東行駛去海岸看日出。

6382.en: Our city is growing economically thanks to new tech industries.
6382.zh: 多虧了新的科技產業，我們城市的經濟正在成長。

6382.en: Buying bulk food is often more economically smart for families.
6382.zh: 對家庭來說，買大包裝食品通常在經濟上更明智。

6384.en: Every good educator cares deeply about their students' future.
6384.zh: 每一位優秀的教育工作者都非常關心學生的未來。

6384.en: The experienced educator shared new teaching methods with us.
6384.zh: 這位經驗豐富的教育家與我們分享了新的教學方法。

6385.en: The fisherman caught a long eel in the local river.
6385.zh: 漁夫在當地河流中抓到了一隻長鰻魚。

6385.en: Grilled eel with sweet soy sauce is a delicious meal.
6385.zh: 刷上甜醬油的烤鰻魚是一道美味的餐點。

6390.en: Students must choose one art elective before next semester.
6390.zh: 學生必須在下學期前選修一門藝術選修課。

6390.en: Photography is my favorite elective class in high school.
6390.zh: 攝影是我高中時最喜歡的選修課程。

6391.en: Water and air are elemental needs for human survival.
6391.zh: 水和空氣是人類生存的基本需求。

6391.en: The painter showed an elemental understanding of colors.
6391.zh: 這位畫家展現了對色彩的基本理解。

6393.en: Only the academic elite can enter this prestigious university.
6393.zh: 只有學術菁英才能進入這所名牌大學。

6393.en: The elite athletes trained hard for the international competition.
6393.zh: 菁英運動員們為了國際比賽而努力訓練。

6394.en: The government placed a trade embargo on the foreign country.
6394.zh: 政府對該國實施了貿易禁運。

6394.en: This strict oil embargo caused fuel prices to rise sharply.
6394.zh: 這項嚴格的石油禁運導致油價急劇上漲。

6396.en: Her volunteer work helps embody the spirit of kindness.
6396.zh: 她的志工服務有助於體現善良的精神。

6396.en: Great leaders often embody honesty, courage, and wisdom.
6396.zh: 偉大的領袖通常體現了誠實、勇氣與智慧。

6397.en: Scientists studied the growth of the plant embryo under light.
6397.zh: 科學家在燈光下研究植物胚胎的生長。

6397.en: The tiny embryo develops rapidly during the early pregnancy stage.
6397.zh: 微小的胚胎在懷孕初期發展得非常快。

6398.en: Scientists need empirical evidence to prove their new theories.
6398.zh: 科學家需要經驗證據來證明他們的新理論。

6398.en: His argument was based on empirical data rather than guesses.
6398.zh: 他的論點是基於實證數據而非猜測。

6399.en: The beautiful melody of the song can enchant every listener.
6399.zh: 這首歌優美的旋律能夠迷住每一位聽眾。

6399.en: Children were completely enchanted by the magic show at school.
6399.zh: 孩子們完全被學校的魔術表演給迷住了。

6402.en: Many young people choose to enlist in the army after graduation.
6402.zh: 許多青年選擇在畢業後從軍入伍。

6402.en: We need to enlist more volunteers for the beach cleanup event.
6402.zh: 我們需要為淨灘活動招募更多志工。

6403.en: Heavy rain and severe traffic jams will ensue this afternoon.
6403.zh: 今天下午將會隨之降下大雨並發生嚴重的交通堵塞。

6403.en: A heated argument ensued after the referee made a bad call.
6403.zh: 裁判做出糟糕的判決後，隨即引發了一場激烈的爭論。

6404.en: This new job will entail a lot of overseas business trips.
6404.zh: 這份新工作將會需要大量的海外出差。

6404.en: Studying abroad usually entails high living costs and heavy pressure.
6404.zh: 出國留學通常會帶來高昂的生活費與沉重的壓力。

6405.en: The architect can envisage what the modern building will look like.
6405.zh: 這位建築師能夠預見這棟現代建築完工後的模樣。

6405.en: Do you envisage any major problems with our new project plan?
6405.zh: 你預見我們的新專案計畫會有任何重大問題嗎？

6406.en: Digestive enzymes help our bodies break down food much faster.
6406.zh: 消化酶有助於我們的身體更快地分解食物。

6406.en: Certain enzymes in pineapple can make raw meat tender.
6406.zh: 鳳梨中的某些酵素可以讓生肉變嫩。

6408.en: The famous author started his novel with a clever epigram.
6408.zh: 這位著名作家用一句巧妙的警句來開啟他的小說。

6408.en: Oscar Wilde is well known for writing many witty epigrams.
6408.zh: 奧斯卡·王爾德以寫出許多機智的警句而聞名。

6417.en: The final math exam this semester was exceedingly difficult for students.
6417.zh: 這學期的期末數學考試對學生來說極其困難。

6417.en: She felt exceedingly nervous before giving her presentation on stage.
6417.zh: 她在臺上做簡報之前感到非常緊張。

6418.en: This parking space is reserved exclusively for disabled drivers.
6418.zh: 這個停車位是專門為身心障礙駕駛人保留的。

6418.en: The fashion magazine is targeted exclusively at young teenage girls.
6418.zh: 這本時尚雜誌專門以年輕少女為目標讀者群。

6420.en: Athletes expend a lot of energy during intense training sessions.
6420.zh: 運動員在激烈的訓練期間會消耗大量的體力。

6420.en: We should not expend too much time on trivial matters.
6420.zh: 我們不應該在瑣碎的事情上花費太多時間。

6421.en: Scientific experimentation requires patience and careful observation.
6421.zh: 科學實驗需要耐心與仔細的觀察。

6421.en: Continuous experimentation helps scientists improve their new technology.
6421.zh: 持續的實驗有助於科學家改善他們的新技術。

6422.en: Her wedding was criticized for its unnecessary extravagance.
6422.zh: 她的婚禮因不必要的鋪張浪費而遭到批評。

6422.en: He lives in extravagance despite the economic downturn.
6422.zh: 儘管經濟不景氣，他仍然過着奢華的生活。

6423.en: The eyewitness provided crucial details about the robbery.
6423.zh: 那名目擊者提供了關於這起搶案的關鍵細節。

6423.en: Police are searching for any eyewitnesses to the accident.
6423.zh: 警方正在尋找這起事故的任何目擊者。

6424.en: He dreams of traveling to faraway countries someday.
6424.zh: 他夢想有一天能到遙遠的國家旅遊。

6424.en: She gazed at the faraway mountains with a smile.
6424.zh: 她帶着微笑凝視着遠處的山脈。

6432.en: Many international students apply to study at FIU every year.
6432.zh: 每年都有許多國際學生申請到佛羅里達國際大學就讀。

6432.en: The campus of FIU offers great resources for research.
6432.zh: 該校園為研究提供了極佳的資源。

6442.en: The festival was filled with music, laughter, and gaiety.
6442.zh: 節慶活動中充滿了音樂、笑聲與歡樂。

6442.en: Her bright yellow dress added gaiety to the party.
6442.zh: 她那件鮮黃色的洋裝為派對增添了歡樂氣氛。

6443.en: People born under Gemini are often seen as adaptable.
6443.zh: 雙子座出生的人通常被認為適應力很強。

6443.en: My best friend is a Gemini who loves talking.
6443.zh: 我最好的朋友是一個很愛聊天雙子座。

6444.en: It is unwise to generalize about all teenagers based on one case.
6444.zh: 根據單一個案就對所有青少年一概而論是不明智的。

6444.en: She tends to generalize when things go wrong.
6444.zh: 當事情出錯時，她習慣性地作概括而論。

6445.en: The local businessman donated generously to the charity.
6445.zh: 當地商人慷慨地捐款給慈善機構。

6445.en: She shared her notes generously with her classmates.
6445.zh: 她很大方地與同學分享她的筆記。

6446.en: He grew up in a poor urban ghetto.
6446.zh: 他在一個貧困的都市貧民區長大。

6446.en: The community project aims to improve housing in the ghetto.
6446.zh: 該社區計畫旨在改善貧民區的居住環境。

6462.en: The gypsy family traveled across Europe in a colorful caravan.
6462.zh: 吉普賽家庭乘著色彩繽紛的大篷車遊歷歐洲。

6462.en: She enjoys the gypsy lifestyle of moving from place to place.
6462.zh: 她很享受這種居無定所的吉普賽生活方式。

6463.en: She spent hours styling her new hairdo for the prom.
6463.zh: 她花了幾個小時為畢業舞會整理她的新髮型。

6463.en: The bride showed off her elegant hairdo to everyone.
6463.zh: 新娘向大家展示她優雅的髮型。

6466.en: Every new employee must read the company safety handbook carefully.
6466.zh: 每位新進員工都必須仔細閱讀公司安全手冊。

6466.en: The student handbook contains all the school rules and regulations.
6466.zh: 學生手冊包含了所有的學校規章制度。

6470.en: These hardy plants can survive in freezing winter temperatures.
6470.zh: 這些耐寒植物能在酷寒的冬天中存活下來。

6470.en: Hardy mountain climbers reached the peak despite the storm.
6470.zh: 堅毅的登山者不顧暴風雨登上了山頂。

6472.en: The teacher spoke harshly to the students who were cheating.
6472.zh: 老師嚴厲地斥責了作弊的學生。

6472.en: Her novel was criticized harshly by several famous book reviewers.
6472.zh: 她的新小說受到了幾位著名書評家嚴厲的批評。

6473.en: He hastily packed his suitcase and ran to catch the train.
6473.zh: 他匆忙收拾行李，跑去趕火車。

6473.en: She hastily signed the contract without reading the fine print.
6473.zh: 她沒有看清楚細則就匆忙簽下了合約。

6474.en: Two cars collided head-on on the slippery highway last night.
6474.zh: 昨晚兩輛車在濕滑的高速公路上迎面相撞。

6474.en: We must face these difficult challenges head-on instead of escaping.
6474.zh: 我們必須正面迎擊這些艱難的挑戰，而不是逃避。

6476.en: The judge pointed out that the witness's statement was mere hearsay.
6476.zh: 法官指出證人的陳述純粹是聽來的傳聞。

6476.en: Police cannot arrest someone based only on gossip and hearsay.
6476.zh: 警方不能僅憑八卦和道聽途說就逮捕任何人。

6478.en: He won the world heavyweight boxing championship last weekend.
6478.zh: 他上周末贏得了世界重量級拳擊冠軍。

6478.en: Tech industry heavyweights gathered to discuss artificial intelligence.
6478.zh: 科技產業的重量級人物齊聚一堂討論人工智慧。

6479.en: The young heiress inherited a massive fortune from her grandfather.
6479.zh: 這位年輕的女繼承人從祖父那裡繼承了一筆巨額財富。

6479.en: Everyone was curious about the billionaire heiress's private life.
6479.zh: 大家都對這位億萬富翁女繼承人的私生活很好奇。

6480.en: Dark clouds often herald a heavy summer thunderstorm.
6480.zh: 烏雲通常預示著會有一場夏日雷雨。

6480.en: The discovery heralds a new era in cancer treatment.
6480.zh: 這項發現預示著癌症治療新時代的到來。

6481.en: The shy student raised her hand hesitantly in class.
6481.zh: 那個害羞的學生在課堂上猶豫地舉起了手。

6481.en: Mark stepped hesitantly into the dark, spooky room.
6481.zh: 馬克猶豫不決地走進那個黑暗而詭異的房間。

6484.en: Many students enjoy living in a multi-ethnic hom.
6484.zh: 許多學生喜歡住在多元文化的宿舍裡。

6484.en: The university hom provides comfortable rooms for freshmen.
6484.zh: 這所大學的宿舍為大一新生提供舒適的房間。

6486.en: The small cafe is famous for its homely atmosphere.
6486.zh: 這間小咖啡館以其家常的溫馨氣氛而聞名。

6486.en: She enjoys cooking homely meals for her family daily.
6486.zh: 她喜歡每天為家人烹調家常飯菜。

6487.en: We watched horrifying news about the earthquake all night.
6487.zh: 我們整晚都在看關於地震的可怕新聞。

6487.en: The driver recalled the horrifying moment of the crash.
6487.zh: 駕駛回憶起那場車禍令人毛骨悚然的瞬間。

6488.en: The famous scientist accepted the prestigious award humbly.
6488.zh: 這位著名的科學家謙虛地接受了這項聲譽卓著的獎項。

6488.en: He apologized humbly for making such a silly mistake.
6488.zh: 他為犯下如此愚蠢的錯誤而謙卑地道歉。

6489.en: He suffered great humiliation after losing the election.
6489.zh: 他在競選失敗後遭受了巨大的羞辱。

6489.en: She tried to hide her humiliation with a fake smile.
6489.zh: 她試圖用假笑來掩飾自己的難堪。

6490.en: The teacher humorously explained the difficult grammar rules.
6490.zh: 老師幽默地解釋了困難的文法規則。

6490.en: John spoke humorously about his disastrous first date.
6490.zh: 約翰幽默地談論了他那場糟糕的第一次約會。

6491.en: Angry protesters began to hurl stones at the police.
6491.zh: 憤怒的抗議者開始向警方投擲石頭。

6491.en: The baseball player can hurl the ball extremely fast.
6491.zh: 這名棒球選手能把球投得極快。

6492.en: The crowd gave a loud hurrah when their team scored.
6492.zh: 當他們的球隊得分時，群眾發出了熱烈的歡呼聲。

6492.en: Children shouted hurrah as school was finally over.
6492.zh: 學校終於放學了，孩子們大聲歡呼。

6493.en: The students sang a traditional hymn during the morning assembly.
6493.zh: 學生們在早會時合唱了一首傳統聖歌。

6493.en: Everyone stood up and joined in singing the church hymn.
6493.zh: 大家都站起來，一起加入唱教會聖歌的行列。

6494.en: Remember to use a hyphen in compound adjectives like well-known.
6494.zh: 記得在像 well-known 這樣的複合形容詞中使用連字號。

6494.en: The teacher pointed out a missing hyphen in my English essay.
6494.zh: 老師指出我英文短文裡少了一個連字號。

6495.en: Citizens strongly condemned the politician's obvious hypocrisy.
6495.zh: 公民們強烈譴責該政治人物明顯的虛偽。

6495.en: His dishonest behavior exposed the hypocrisy of his recent speech.
6495.zh: 他狡猾的行為揭露了他最近演說的虛偽。

6496.en: The little girl became hysterical when she lost her mother.
6496.zh: 小女孩找不到媽媽時變得歇斯底里。

6496.en: Fans went hysterical when the pop star appeared on stage.
6496.zh: 當流行巨星出現在舞台上時，歌迷們情緒歇斯底里。

6497.en: Many people believe that a high I.Q. guarantees future success.
6497.zh: 許多人相信高智商能保證未來的成功。

6497.en: A person's I.Q. score does not measure emotional intelligence.
6497.zh: 一個人的智商分數無法衡量情緒智商。

6499.en: The two political parties had deep ideological differences.
6499.zh: 這兩個政黨有很深的意識形態分歧。

6499.en: Their debate was driven by ideological conflicts rather than facts.
6499.zh: 他們的辯論是由意識形態衝突而非事實所驅動。

6502.en: It is illogical to expect different results using the same method.
6502.zh: 用相同的方法卻期待不同的結果是不合邏輯的。

6502.en: His excuse for missing the final exam sounded completely illogical.
6502.zh: 他缺席期末考的藉口聽起來完全不合邏輯。

6503.en: Stealing money from charity organizations is totally immoral.
6503.zh: 從慈善機構偷錢是完全不道德的。

6503.en: The CEO resigned after his immoral business practices were exposed.
6503.zh: 執行長在不道德的商業做法被揭露後辭職了。

6504.en: Lack of sleep can seriously impair your concentration at school.
6504.zh: 睡眠不足會嚴重損害你在學校的專注力。

6504.en: Loud music played through earphones may impair your hearing.
6504.zh: 透過耳機播放的大聲音樂可能會損害你的聽力。

6507.en: Online shopping can sometimes feel very cold and impersonal.
6507.zh: 網路購物有時候會讓人覺得非常冷漠且缺乏人性。

6507.en: Large hospitals often provide impersonal service to patients.
6507.zh: 大型醫院經常向病患提供缺乏人情味的服務。

6510.en: His inability to focus made him miss important details.
6510.zh: 他無法專心，導致他錯過了重要的細節。

6510.en: Financial problems caused her inability to finish college.
6510.zh: 財務問題造成她無法完成大學學業。

6512.en: Incidentally, have you seen my keys anywhere?
6512.zh: 順便問一下，你有在哪裡看到我的鑰匙嗎？

6512.en: He mentioned, incidentally, that he would leave tomorrow.
6512.zh: 他順便提到，他明天就要離開了。

6513.en: She showed a strong inclination toward studying art.
6513.zh: 她展現出對研讀藝術的濃厚傾向。

6513.en: My natural inclination is to stay home on weekends.
6513.zh: 我天生的傾向是週末待在家裡。

6514.en: The teacher rejected my report because it was incomplete.
6514.zh: 老師退回我的報告，因為它不完整。

6514.en: Please do not submit incomplete forms to the office.
6514.zh: 請不要繳交未填寫完整的表格給辦公室。

6515.en: The bus schedule is very inconvenient for local residents.
6515.zh: 公車時刻表對當地居民來說很不方便。

6515.en: I hope my call at this hour is not inconvenient.
6515.zh: 我希望我這個時間打電話沒有造成不便。

6516.en: We are deeply indebted to our teachers for their guidance.
6516.zh: 我們深深感謝老師們的指導。

6516.en: The young entrepreneur was heavily indebted after the failure.
6516.zh: 這位年輕企業家失敗後負債累累。

6517.en: His prolonged indecision caused us to miss the train.
6517.zh: 他猶豫不決太久，導致我們錯過火車。

6517.en: She suffered from much indecision before choosing a major.
6517.zh: 她在選擇主修前經歷了許多猶豫不決。

6519.en: Test scores are not the only indicator of success.
6519.zh: 考試成績並不是成功的唯一指標。

6519.en: High unemployment is a clear economic indicator.
6519.zh: 高失業率是一個明顯的經濟指標。

6520.en: He suffered from indigestion after eating too much fast food.
6520.zh: 他吃太多速食後患有消化不良。

6520.en: Eating late at night often causes stomach indigestion.
6520.zh: 深夜進食經常會引起胃部消化不良。

6521.en: The new policy caused widespread indignation among students.
6521.zh: 這項新政策在學生之間引起了廣泛的憤慨。

6521.en: She expressed her indignation at the unfair treatment.
6521.zh: 她對這種不公平的待遇表達了憤怒。

6524.en: The industrious students always finish their projects ahead of time.
6524.zh: 那些勤奮的學生總是提前完成他們的專題。

6524.en: She is an industrious worker who never complains about heavy workloads.
6524.zh: 她是個勤勞的員工，從不抱怨繁重的工作量。

6525.en: His previous strategy proved ineffective in solving the traffic problem.
6525.zh: 他先前的策略被證明無法有效解決交通問題。

6525.en: We need to replace the ineffective policy as soon as possible.
6525.zh: 我們需要盡快取代這項無效的政策。

6527.en: Students often look for inexpensive textbooks to save some money.
6527.zh: 學生們經常尋找便宜的教科書來省點錢。

6527.en: This restaurant offers delicious food at a relatively inexpensive price.
6527.zh: 這家餐廳以相對便宜的價格提供美味的食物。

6528.en: The brave infantry marched through the thick mud and rain.
6528.zh: 勇敢的步兵冒著厚重的泥濘和雨水行軍。

6528.en: Soldiers in the infantry received special training for rough terrain.
6528.zh: 步兵團的士兵接受了針對崎嶇地形的特殊訓練。

6529.en: We can make a logical inference from the available data.
6529.zh: 我們可以從現有的數據中做出合乎邏輯的推論。

6529.en: Her inference about the mysterious event turned out to be correct.
6529.zh: 她對那起神祕事件的推斷證明是正確的。

6532.en: The inventor solved the difficult problem using sheer ingenuity.
6532.zh: 這位發明家憑藉著純粹的巧思解決了這個難題。

6532.en: Building this complex machine required great human ingenuity.
6532.zh: 建造這台複雜的機器需要高度的人類智慧與巧思。

6534.en: The inquisitive child asked the science teacher many difficult questions.
6534.zh: 這名好奇的孩子問了自然老師許多困難的問題。

6534.en: An inquisitive mind is essential for scientific research and discovery.
6534.zh: 好奇心對於科學研究與發現是不可或缺的。

6537.en: Economic instability often leads to a rise in the unemployment rate.
6537.zh: 經濟動盪經常導致失業率上升。

6537.en: The political instability worried many foreign investors around the world.
6537.zh: 政治局勢的不穩定讓許多外國投資人感到擔憂。

6539.en: The university is undergoing major institutional changes this year.
6539.zh: 這所大學今年正在經歷重大的制度改革。

6539.en: They are trying to eliminate institutional racism in the workplace.
6539.zh: 他們正試圖消除職場中的體制性種族主義。

6540.en: He apologized immediately after making such an insulting remark.
6540.zh: 他在說出如此侮辱人的話後立刻道歉了。

6540.en: Her insulting behavior made everyone at the dinner party uncomfortable.
6540.zh: 她那侮辱人的舉止讓晚宴上的每個人都感到不舒服。

6541.en: Water is an integral part of a healthy diet.
6541.zh: 水是健康飲食不可或缺的一部分。

6541.en: Teamwork plays an integral role in this company.
6541.zh: 團隊合作在這家公司扮演著不可或缺的角色。

6542.en: The speaker made his complex ideas easily intelligible.
6542.zh: 演講者把他複雜的想法表達得很容易理解。

6542.en: Please write your answers in clear and intelligible handwriting.
6542.zh: 請用清晰易懂的字跡寫下你的答案。

6543.en: The police managed to intercept the stolen vehicle quickly.
6543.zh: 警方設法迅速攔截了失竊車輛。

6543.en: Secret agents tried to intercept the enemy's radio messages.
6543.zh: 祕密特務試圖攔截敵人的無線電訊息。

6544.en: These two batteries are completely interchangeable for the camera.
6544.zh: 這兩顆電池裝在相機裡是可以完全互換的。

6544.en: Some people think these two words are interchangeable.
6544.zh: 有些人認為這兩個詞是可以互換使用的。

6545.en: Social intercourse is important for teenagers at school.
6545.zh: 社交互動對學校裡的青少年來說很重要。

6545.en: Good cultural intercourse promotes friendship between nations.
6545.zh: 良好的文化交流促進了國家間的友誼。

6546.en: The artist created an intricate design on the wall.
6546.zh: 那位藝術家在牆上創作了一個複雜精細的設計。

6546.en: We need to solve this intricate problem together.
6546.zh: 我們需要一起解決這個錯綜複雜的問題。

6548.en: The young entrepreneur is looking for a rich investor.
6548.zh: 這位年輕企業家正在尋找一位有錢的投資者。

6548.en: Many foreign investors are interested in the tech industry.
6548.zh: 許多外國投資者對科技產業很感興趣。

6551.en: The lawyer decided to invoke a new law in court.
6551.zh: 律師決定在法庭上引用一項新法律。

6551.en: People often invoke ancient traditions during the festival.
6551.zh: 人們經常在節慶期間喚起古老的傳統。

6552.en: He took a deep breath and looked inward for peace.
6552.zh: 他深吸了一氣，並向內心尋求平靜。

6552.en: The heavy wooden door can only be pushed inward.
6552.zh: 這扇厚重的木門只能往內推。

6554.en: Please do not bring up irrelevant topics in class.
6554.zh: 請不要在課堂上提出不相關的話題。

6554.en: His personal opinion is totally irrelevant to this case.
6554.zh: 他的個人意見與這個案件完全無關。

6560.en: Students should not jaywalk across the busy street.
6560.zh: 學生不應該違規穿越這條車水馬龍的街道。

6560.en: He was fined for jaywalking near the school gate.
6560.zh: 他因為在校門口附近違規穿越馬路而被罰款。

6565.en: Is there any justification for breaking school rules?
6565.zh: 打破學校規定有任何正當理由嗎？

6565.en: She offered no justification for her sudden absence.
6565.zh: 她沒有為自己突然缺席提出任何合理的解釋。

6566.en: The brave firefighter was justly rewarded by the mayor.
6566.zh: 這位勇敢的消防員獲得市長公正的獎勵。

6566.en: She is justly famous for her contributions to science.
6566.zh: 她對科學的貢獻享譽名歸。

6567.en: The students are keenly awaiting the final exam results.
6567.zh: 同學們正熱切地等待期末考試成績。

6567.en: She felt the loss of her pet very keenly.
6567.zh: 她深刻地感受到失去寵物的痛苦。

6571.en: We bought a king-size bed for our new apartment.
6571.zh: 我們為新公寓買了一張特大號床。

6571.en: He ordered a king-size burger at the fast-food shop.
6571.zh: 他在速食店點了一個特大號漢堡。

6573.en: Building this robot requires advanced technical know-how.
6573.zh: 製造這台機器人需要先進的技術知識。

6573.en: She has the marketing know-how to boost sales.
6573.zh: 她具備能提升銷售額的行銷專業技能。

6575.en: The wise lama taught villagers about peace and kindness.
6575.zh: 這位明智的喇嘛向村民講授和平與善良。

6575.en: Many tourists visit the monastery to meet the high lama.
6575.zh: 許多遊客造訪寺院以拜見高僧。

6576.en: Fans continue to lament the sudden death of the singer.
6576.zh: 歌迷們持續哀嘆這位歌手的驟然離世。

6925.zh: 我們在寧靜的山湖旁享受了一個安詳的下午。

6925.en: The library provides a tranquil environment for students to study.
6925.zh: 圖書館提供學生一個平靜的環境來讀書。

6926.en: The veterinarian used a tranquilizer to calm the wild animal.
6926.zh: 獸醫使用鎮靜劑來安撫這隻野生動物。

6926.en: Some patients need tranquilizers to cope with severe anxiety.
6926.zh: 有些患者需要鎮靜劑來應付嚴重的焦慮。

6928.en: Hikers must traverse the steep mountain trail with great care.
6928.zh: 健行者必須非常小心地橫穿這條陡峭的山徑。

6928.en: The new bridge allows cars to traverse the wide river easily.
6928.zh: 新橋讓汽車能輕鬆橫跨這條寬闊的河流。

6929.en: Signs were posted to warn people not to trespass on the property.
6929.zh: 張貼了告示警告人們切勿侵入該私人房產。

6929.en: The hunter was arrested for trespassing in the nature reserve.
6929.zh: 該名獵人因闖入自然保護區而被逮捕。

6930.en: The speaker stood on the tribune to address the angry crowd.
6930.zh: 演講者站在講臺上向憤怒的人群發表演說。

6930.en: A local tribune defended the rights of poor workers.
6930.zh: 一位地方保民官捍衛了貧窮工人的權利。

6931.en: The triumphant team lifted the championship trophy high in the air.
6931.zh: 獲勝的隊伍高高舉起了冠軍獎盃。

6931.en: She felt triumphant after passing the difficult college entrance exam.
6931.zh: 通過困難的學測後，她感到得意洋洋。

6934.en: Public health campaigns have successfully reduced tuberculosis cases globally.
6934.zh: 公共衛生運動已在全球成功減少了結核病病例。

6934.en: My grandfather spent months recovering from tuberculosis in the hospital.
6934.zh: 我爺爺在醫院花了好幾個月才從結核病中康復。

6941.en: My grandfather still keeps his old typewriter on the wooden desk.
6941.zh: 我爺爺仍然把他的舊打字機放在木桌上。

6941.en: Writing letters with a typewriter requires a lot of patience.
6941.zh: 用打字機寫信需要很大的耐心。

6943.en: The cruel tyrant was finally overthrown by the brave citizens.
6943.zh: 這個殘暴的暴君最終被勇敢的市民推翻了。

6943.en: Students sometimes view strict teachers as modern tyrants.
6943.zh: 學生有時會把嚴格的老師視為現代暴君。

6944.en: Stress and poor eating habits can easily cause a stomach ulcer.
6944.zh: 壓力和不良飲食習慣很容易引起胃潰瘍。

6944.en: The doctor advised him to avoid spicy food for his ulcer.
6944.zh: 醫生建議他為了潰瘍要避免吃辛辣食物。

6950.en: She nodded unconsciously while listening to the boring lecture.
6950.zh: 她在聽沉悶的講課時，不知不覺地點了頭。

6950.en: He bit his nails unconsciously when he felt nervous.
6950.zh: 他感到緊張時，會不知不覺地咬指甲。

6952.en: Her anger at the unfair decision is completely understandable.
6952.zh: 她對這個不公決定感到生氣是完全可以理解的。

6952.en: It is understandable that students worry about their future.
6952.zh: 學生擔憂自己的未來是可以理解的。

6953.en: The local government agreed to underwrite the costs of the festival.
6953.zh: 當地政府同意承擔該節慶的費用。

6953.en: An insurance company will underwrite the risk of the project.
6953.zh: 保險公司將為該專案的風險提供擔保。

6955.en: We should not put undue pressure on high school students.
6955.zh: 我們不應該給高中生施加過度的壓力。

6955.en: The new regulations caused undue delay in the construction work.
6955.zh: 新法規導致了工程不必要的延誤。

6960.en: It was unfortunate that the outdoor concert was canceled.
6960.zh: 戶外音樂會被迫取消，實在是相當不幸。

6960.en: She made an unfortunate mistake during the important interview.
6960.zh: 她在重要的面試中犯了一個不該有的錯誤。

6961.en: He seemed ungrateful for all the help we gave him.
6961.zh: 對於我們給他的所有幫助，他似乎顯得不知感恩。

6961.en: It is ungrateful to complain about such a nice gift.
6961.zh: 抱怨這麼棒的禮物是一種不知感恩的行為。

6964.en: The workers began to unload the heavy boxes from the truck.
6964.zh: 工人們開始從卡車上卸下沉重的箱子。

6964.en: She needed time to unload her worries to a close friend.
6964.zh: 她需要時間向摯友傾訴心中的憂慮。

6965.en: They had an unofficial meeting to discuss the new project.
6965.zh: 他們舉行了一場非正式會議來討論新專案。

6965.en: That piece of news is still purely unofficial at this moment.
6965.zh: 那則消息目前依然純屬非官方流傳。

6968.en: Political unrest in the country affected the tourism industry badly.
6968.zh: 國內的政治動盪嚴重打擊了觀光產業。

6968.en: The university campus experienced student unrest over tuition hikes.
6968.zh: 該大學校園因學費調漲而發生了學生動亂。

6969.en: The ancient temple remained untouched by modern development.
6969.zh: 這座古老的寺廟並未受到現代開發的破壞。

6969.en: He left his dinner completely untouched because of a headache.
6969.zh: 因為頭痛，他的晚餐完全一口都沒有動。

6971.en: Her strict upbringing helped her develop great self-discipline.
6971.zh: 她嚴格的教養幫助她培養了極佳的自律能力。

6971.en: Children's behavior often reflects their family background and upbringing.
6971.zh: 孩子的行為往往反映了他們的家庭背景與成長環境。

6972.en: The sudden news completely upended our travel plans.
6972.zh: 這則突如其來的消息徹底打亂了我們的旅遊計畫。

6972.en: New technology can upend traditional ways of doing business.
6972.zh: 新科技可能會顛覆傳統的商業運作方式。

6974.en: The strong typhoon managed to uproot several old trees.
6974.zh: 強烈颱風把好幾棵老樹都連根拔起了。

6974.en: Moving to a new city meant she had to uproot her life.
6974.zh: 搬到新城市意味著她必須徹底改變生活環境。

6975.en: Uranium is a heavy metal used to generate nuclear power.
6975.zh: 鈾是一種用來發電的重金屬。

6975.en: Scientists detected traces of uranium in the rock samples.
6975.zh: 科學家在岩石樣本中檢測到了微量的鈾。

6976.en: The old computer still has great usefulness for basic tasks.
6976.zh: 這台舊電腦對於基本任務仍具有很大的實用性。

6976.en: We debated the usefulness of this new school rule.
6976.zh: 我們辯論了這項新學校規定的有用性。

6979.en: Many writers have tried to describe a peaceful Utopia.
6979.zh: 許多作家都試圖描述一個和平的烏托邦。

6979.en: He realized that a true Utopia does not exist.
6979.zh: 他意識到真正的烏托邦是不存在的。

6982.en: The teacher questioned the validity of my scientific data.
6982.zh: 老師質疑了我科學數據的有效性。

6982.en: Scientists are testing the validity of the research method.
6982.zh: 科學家們正在檢驗該研究方法的正確性。

6983.en: She needed a safe place to vent her anger.
6983.zh: 她需要一個安全的地方來宣洩她的憤怒。

6983.en: He opened the window to vent the bad smell.
6983.zh: 他打開窗戶來排散難聞的氣味。

6987.en: The difficult math problem began to vex the student.
6987.zh: 這道困難的數學題開始使那個學生感到煩惱。

6987.en: Her constant complaints would vex anyone in the office.
6987.zh: 她不斷的抱怨會惹惱辦公室裡的任何人。

6988.en: Online scammers often victimize naive elderly people.
6988.zh: 網路詐騙犯經常使天真的老人受害。

6988.en: School bullies should never be allowed to victimize others.
6988.zh: 絕對不能允許校園惡霸去欺凌其他人。

6991.en: She is known for her virtuous and helpful nature.
6991.zh: 她以其善良且樂於助人的本性而聞名。

6991.en: The old story teaches children to live a virtuous life.
6991.zh: 這個古老的故事教導孩子們過著有道德的生活。

6992.en: Try to visualize the final result of your project.
6992.zh: 試著在腦海中想像你專案的最終成果。

6992.en: The teacher used charts to help students visualize the data.
6992.zh: 老師用圖表來幫助學生將數據視覺化。

6993.en: Long skirts are back in vogue this season.
6993.zh: 長裙在本季又重新流行起來了。

6993.en: Vintage clothes are currently all the vogue among teens.
6993.zh: 復古服裝目前在青少年之間大為流行。

6995.en: My father used to listen to music on a Walkman.
6995.zh: 我父親以前習慣用隨身聽聽音樂。

6995.en: The vintage Walkman is now a valuable collector item.
6995.zh: 那台古董隨身聽現在是一個很有價值的收藏品。

6997.en: The huge warship sailed across the ocean peacefully.
6997.zh: 那艘巨大的軍艦平靜地航行過海洋。

6997.en: Taiwan sent a warship to monitor the nearby sea.
6997.zh: 台灣派出一艘軍艦去監控附近海域。

6998.en: They found a stray puppy by the dusty wayside.
6998.zh: 他們在佈滿灰塵的路邊發現了一隻流浪小狗。

6998.en: Many traditional customs fall by the wayside nowadays.
6998.zh: 許多傳統習俗如今漸漸被淘汰了。

7001.en: They established a new system whereby students could choose classes.
7001.zh: 他們建立了一個新制度，藉此學生可以自由選課。

7001.en: She signed a contract whereby she agreed to work overtime.
7001.zh: 她簽了一份合約，據此她同意加班。

7003.en: The young man was wholly responsible for the accident.
7003.zh: 這名年輕男子要為這起意外負完全的責任。

7003.en: Her novel was based on a wholly true story.
7003.zh: 她的小說是以一個完全真實的故事為基礎。

7004.en: The excited fans cheered wildly for the pop singer.
7004.zh: 激動的粉絲們為這位流行歌手瘋狂歡呼。

7004.en: Real estate prices in Taipei are wildly expensive.
7004.zh: 台北的房地產價格貴得離譜。

7008.en: This modern building can withstand a strong earthquake easily.
7008.zh: 這棟現代建築可以輕鬆抵擋強烈的地震。

7008.en: Only tough plants can withstand the cold winter weather.
7008.zh: 只有強韌的植物才能禁得起寒冷的冬天天氣。

7010.en: Rescuers searched for survivors among the airplane wreckage.
7010.zh: 救援人員在飛機殘骸中搜尋倖存者。

7010.en: The storm left a large amount of wreckage on the beach.
7010.zh: 暴風雨在海灘上留下了大量的殘骸。

7012.en: She dreams of studying law at Yale University someday.
7012.zh: 她夢想有一天能在耶魯大學修讀法律。

7012.en: A famous professor from Yale gave a speech today.
7012.zh: 一位來自耶魯的知名教授今天發表了演講。

7013.en: Bakers use yeast to make the bread dough rise.
7013.zh: 麵包師傅使用酵母來讓麵團膨脹。

7013.en: Remember to add active yeast into the warm water.
7013.zh: 記得把活性酵母加入溫水中。

7014.en: The volunteer showed great zeal for community service work.
7014.zh: 這位志工對社區服務工作展現出極大的熱忱。

7014.en: He studied English grammar with remarkable zeal every night.
7014.zh: 他每天晚上都以驚人的熱情研讀英文文法。

7015.en: The volunteers worked zealously to clean up the beach.
7015.zh: 志工們熱心地清理海灘。

7015.en: She studied zealously for the upcoming college entrance exam.
7015.zh: 她為了即將到來的學測而努力不懈地讀書。

7017.en: He decided to major in zoology at the university.
7017.zh: 他決定在大學主修動物學。

7017.en: Modern zoology focuses on animal behavior and habitat conservation.
7017.zh: 現代動物學著重於動物行為與棲息地保育。
